articleTitle: The Future of Optical Transport: Architectures and Technologies from an Operator Perspective
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This tutorial paper reviews recent developments in optical transport architectures from an operator's perspective, focusing on how coherent technologies will push towards the network edge

articleTitle: Introduction to Continuous Variable Quantum Key Distribution
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: In this talk, we will review the present status of continuous-variable quantum key distribution, including optical configuration and security analysis, and would like to discuss future prospects for integration with coherent optical communications.

articleTitle: 0.174 dB/km Hollow Core Double Nested Antiresonant Nodeless Fiber (DNANF)
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report the first double-nested antiresonant hollow core fiber. The fiber matches the loss of commercial solid core fibers in the C-band (0.174 dB/km) and fundamentally improves it (0.22 dB/km) in the O-band.

articleTitle: Location-resolved PDL Monitoring with Rx-side Digital Signal Processing in Multi-span Optical Transmission System
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a novel monitoring that enables to localize PDL in multi-span transmission using only Rx-side DSP and experimentally demonstrate sufficient accuracy within error of 1km with eighty-two polarization combinations in three-span, 180-km transmission line.

articleTitle: Uncoupled Multi-core Fiber Design for Practical Bidirectional Optical Communications
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We review and discuss the design factors and considerations on MCFs for bidirectional transmissions, including connection polarity and crosstalk requirements. We also introduce MCFs suitable for bidirectional long-haul and short-reach transmissions. © 2022 The Author

articleTitle: Geometric Constellation Shaping for Phase-noise Channels Using a Differentiable Blind Phase Search
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We perform geometric constellation shaping with optimized bit labeling using a binary auto-encoder including a differential blind phase search (BPS). Our approach enables full end-to-end training of optical coherent transceivers taking into account the digital signal processing. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Investigation of Potential FEC Schemes for 800G-ZR Forward Error Correction
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: With a record 400Gbps 100-piece-FPGA implementation, we investigate performance of the potential FEC schemes for OIF-800GZR. By comparing the power dissipation and correction threshold at 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−15</sup> BER, we proposed the simplified OFEC for the 800G-ZR FEC.

articleTitle: Ultra-compact silicon modulator with 110 GHz bandwidth
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate an ultra-compact silicon slow light modulator with a record-high EO bandwidth of 110 GHz, a modulation length of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$124\ \mu\mathrm{m}$</tex>, an optical bandwidth of 8 nm around 1550 nm, and OOK transmission beyond 110 Gbps without DSP is achieved. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: First Demonstration of Uncoupled 4-Core Multicore Fiber in a Submarine Cable Prototype with Integrated Multicore EDFA
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate the first 15.2 km prototype of submarine cable with 4-core MCF. Cabled MCF changes are negligible. We confirmed MC-EDFA integration to the cable improves Q-value by 0.6 dB through real-time 5,350 km transmission. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Link Power Optimization for S+C+L Multi-band WDM Coherent Transmission Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We compare S+C+L link power optimization based on the fast and simple heuristic balance of linear and nonlinear noises versus more complex ML-based techniques to estimate optimum per-band line amplifier settings for system capacity maximization. © 2021 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Radio-over-Fiber Transmission Supporting 65536-QAM at 25GHz Band with High-Pass Delta-Sigma Modulation and RF fading Mitigation
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate radio-over-fiber transmission of 44.4Gb/s 65536-QAM at 25GHz employing 2-bit high-pass delta-sigma modulation. 0.19% EVM is achieved after 10km C-band SSMF transmission, and dispersion-induced RF fading is mitigated by differential skew-enabled spectral shaping.

articleTitle: Domain Adaptation: the Key Enabler of Neural Network Equalizers in Coherent Optical Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We introduce the domain adaptation and randomization approach for calibrating neural network-based equalizers for real transmissions, using synthetic data. The approach renders up to 99% training process reduction, which we demonstrate in three experimental setups. © 2021 The Author(s)

articleTitle: 800 Gbps Fully Integrated Silicon Photonics Transmitter for Data Center Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A fully integrated 800 Gbps PAM-4 2×FR4 and DR8 silicon photonics transmitter with eight heterogeneously integrated DFB lasers is demonstrated for data center applications over a temperature range of 0∼70°C and a reach of up to 2 km. © 2022 The Authors

articleTitle: Demonstration of Real-time Photonics-assisted mm- Wave Communication based on Ka-band Large-scale Phased-array Antenna and Automatic Beam Tracking Technique
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Based on 256-element phased-array antenna and photonics-assisted mm-Wave communication, we successfully demonstrate real-time bi-directional 1.5Gbps uncompressed high-definition video transmissions at 26.5~29.5GHz. The FPGA-based self-steering beamforming has been implemented using the proposed automatic beam tracking technique. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Localization of Reflection Induced Multi-Path-Interference Over Multi-Span Transmission Link by Receiver-side Digital Signal Processing
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose and experimentally demonstrate a localization method of reflection induced multi-path-interference over multi-span transmission link by post digital signal processing of received signal obtained by a coherent receiver at the end of the transmission. © 2021 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Techno-Economic Potential of Wavelength-Selective Band-Switchable OXC in S+C+L Band Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Techno-economic performance of an S+C+L-band network employing the wavelength-selective band-switchable optical cross-connect is investigated. Numerical results verify that a significant cost-per-bit reduction can be achieved compared to conventional multi-band and multi-fiber solutions under realistic conditions. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Hybrid CAP / mm-wave OFDM Vector Modulation for Photonic Frequency Conversion in a Single-Sideband Feeder
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate the simultaneous radio-over-fiber feed of 16-QAM 10-Gb/s CAP and 1-GHz OFDM radio at 28-GHz for HetNets. Independent sideband modulation yields photonic up-conversion to the mm-wave band and a dispersion-tolerant feed over 70km. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Precise Longitudinal Power Monitoring over 2,080 km Enabled by Step Size Selection of Split Step Fourier Method
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a step-size optimization scheme of the split-step Fourier method for longitudinal power profile monitoring. We observe only a 1.06-dB root-mean-square error from the theoretical power profile for a 2,080-km transmission link. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Mitigating Nonlinear Interference by Limiting Energy Variations in Sphere Shaping
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Band-trellis enumerative sphere shaping is proposed to decrease the energy variations in channel input sequences. Against sphere shaping, 0.74 dB SNR gain and up to 9% increase in data rates are demonstrated for single-span systems. © 2021 The Author(s)

articleTitle: A Dynamic Multi-Protocol Entanglement Distribution Quantum Network
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We implement a six-user quantum communication network utilising a quantum-enabled ROADM for flexible and on-demand allocation of entanglement across different users. This allows dynamic networking for multiple quantum protocols. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: High Electrical Spectral Efficiency Silicon Photonic Receiver with Carrier-Assisted Differential Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a silicon photonic carrier-assisted differential detection receiver with a single-polarization 224-Gb/s 16-QAM signal transmitted through 80-km SMF. For an integrated direct detection receiver with transmission demonstration, we achieve the highest electrical spectral efficiency/# of polarizations of 6.4 (net 4.6) b/s/Hz. © 2022 The Authors

articleTitle: Segmented Silicon Photonic Modulator with a 67-GHz Bandwidth for High-Speed Signaling
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate an all-silicon segmented modulator with an electro-optic bandwidth beyond 67 GHz and a V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">π</inf> of 5V. Transmission of 120-Gbaud 8-ASK (336.4 Gb/s net) is achieved. © 2021 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Experimental Demonstration of Real-Time 400G Coherent Transmission over 300m OM3 MMF
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate real-time coherent transmission up to 400Gbps over 300m OM3 multimode fibers, showing resilience to connector offsets up to 3–6 µm and fiber mechanical shaking using rigorous TIA-455-203 procedures. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: 3-mode Real-time MDM Transmission Using Single-mode OTN Transceivers over 300 km Weakly-coupled FMF
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Utilizing non-degenerate LP<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">01</inf>/LP<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">02</inf>/LP<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">03</inf> modes in a weakly-coupled 10-LP-mode multiple-ring-core FMF and corresponding mode multiplexers/demultiplexers consisting of cascaded mode-selective fiber couplers, we experimentally demonstrate a real-time 300-km MDM transmission with commercial single-mode 200G OTN transceivers. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: 210 nm E, S, C and L Band Multistage Discrete Raman Amplifier
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a multistage Raman amplifier for 210 nm signal amplification with 15 dB gain and 8.1 dB maximum noise figure enabling ESCL-band transmission with 10 Gb/s NRZ signals over 70 km SMF. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Actively Steerable Integrated Optical Phased Array (OPA) for Optical Wireless Communication (OWC)
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose and demonstrate an actively-controlled optical-beam-steering optical-wireless-communication (OWC) system using an integrated optical-phased-array (OPA). We numerically and experimentally evaluate field-of-view (FOV), beam divergence angle and bit-error-rate (BER) performance of the emitted optical signal. © 2022 Author(s)

articleTitle: Model-aided Geometrical Shaping of Dual-polarization 4D Formats in the Nonlinear Fiber Channel
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The geometry of dual-polarization four-dimensional constellations is optimized in the optical fiber channel using a recent nonlinear interference model. A 0.27 bit/4D rate gain and 13% reach increase are attained compared to polarization-multiplexed formats. © 2021 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Core and Wavelength Allocation of Sending-or-not-sending Quantum Key Distribution for Future Metropolitan Networks over Multicore Fiber
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose core and wavelength allocation schemes of SNS-QKD for future metropolitan transmission over multicore fiber. Experiments verify that the proposed schemes can suppress noise photons up to 57.54% compared to conventional channel allocation. © 2021 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Photonics-based Multiband Radar Fusion with Millimeter-level Range Resolution
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Photonics-based multiband radar fusion is demonstrated in which three photonics-based radars with a 2-GHz bandwidth are successfully fused to have an 18-GHz bandwidth response. Based on this technique, millimeter-level range resolution radar imaging is achieved.

articleTitle: Optical Amplification-Free 200 Gbaud On-Off Keying Link for Intra-Data Center Communications
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a 200 Gbaud OOK link without any optical amplification using C-band externally modulated laser with 3.3 dBm of modulated output power. We achieve below 6.25% overhead HD-FEC threshold after 200 meters of SMF. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: High Degree ROADM Cluster Node
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A low-cost ROADM cluster node with flexible add/drop and scalable to 100s of degree is proposed for next generation optical networks. It disaggregate line and add/drop functions of the cluster into different chassis. A proposed order-based connection management algorithm achieves better than 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−4</sup> blocking despite less than 30% dilation in cluster design. © 2021 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Federated Learning Approach for Lifetime Prediction of Semiconductor Lasers
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A new privacy-preserving federated learning framework allowing laser manufacturers to collaboratively build a robust ML-based laser lifetime prediction model, is proposed. It achieves a mean absolute error of 0.1 years and a significant performance improvement. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Intelligent Burst Receiving Control in 100G Coherent PON with 4×25G TFDM Upstream Transmission
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We proposed novel burst-receiving technologies, including power rebalancing and sub-channel recognition, in a 100G coherent PON with 4×25G-TFDM sub-channels. Superior burst-receiver performance is achieved over 80-km fiber with −39.2-dBm sensitivity and 2.4-GHz sub-channel frequency-detuning tolerance. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Perimeter Intrusion Detection with Backscattering Enhanced Fiber Using Telecom Cables as Sensing Backhaul
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report field test results of facility perimeter intrusion detection with distributed-fiber-sensing technology and backscattering-enhanced-fiber by using deployed telecom fiber cables as sensing backhaul. Various intrusive activities, such as walking/jumping at >100ft distance, are detected. © 2021

articleTitle: Automated Tuning for Silicon Photonic Filters
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: An automatic monitor-based filter tuning technique for APF-based silicon photonic filters is presented. The proposed tuning approach calibrates the initial distorted filter response due to process variation by adjusting the locations of each pole and zero to reconfigure to different bandwidths and center wavelengths.

articleTitle: Demonstration of thin-film lithium niobate high-bandwidth coherent driver modulator
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate the performance of a high-bandwidth coherent driver modulator device, based on thin-film lithium niobate DP-IQ MZI modulators with excellent DC drift characteristics making it suitable for commercial applications. © 2022 The Authors

articleTitle: Coherent DSP and System Integration Technologies for 800G
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This paper discusses challenges in achieving low-power coherent pluggables for 800G, and innovations required to overcome those challenges. Recent progress in the areas of system integration and low-power DSP design and implementation will be surveyed. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: 4-Dimensional IQ Characteristic Estimation for Polarization-multiplexed Coherent Transceivers
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We developed an estimation method that enables frequency-resolved 4-Dimensional (4D) IQ impairment characterization of polarization-multiplexed transceivers in the presence of arbitrary crosstalk across four IQ lanes. We demonstrated the method with 96-Gbaud 16QAM signals. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: MicroLED Array-based Optical Links Using Imaging Fiber for Chip-to-chip Communications
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate high density (2Tb/mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>), very low energy per bit (<2pJ/bit), high sensitivity (<-21dBm), and low crosstalk (<-20dB) in various configurations for optical transmission using high speed blue LEDs and integrated photodetector/amplifiers fabricated in 130nm CMOS process.

articleTitle: Modal Loss Characterisation of Thick Ring Core Fiber Using Perfect Vortex Beams
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Using a programmable demultiplexer to validate launch conditions, we develop a mode-dependent loss (MDL) measurement method for fiber orbital angular momentum modes. We uncover spread in MDL and confirm low crosstalk in our fiber design. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Architecture to Deploy and Operate a Digital Twin Optical Network
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose an architecture to deploy Digital Twin Optical Networks (DTON), which provide a virtual representation of the physical optical network. DTON allow the assessment of specific behaviors before actual implementation in the physical network. ©2022 The Authors.

articleTitle: Fast optical frequency detection techniques for coherent distributed sensing and communication systems
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present techniques for detecting fast optical frequency variations with high spectral resolution for coherent detection based distributed sensing and communication systems, for which conventional spectral measurement techniques cannot meet the speed and spectral resolution requirements.

articleTitle: Novel Mirror-flipped Mode Permutation Technique for Long-haul Mode-division Multiplexing Transmissions
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a mirror-flipped mode permutation scheme based on newly developed differential-mode-delay-symmetric fibers, which further suppresses modal-dispersion impact by 30% and mitigates mode-dependent-loss impact with 3.8-dB Q-factor improvement compared with the traditional permutation method in 1028-km 6-mode transmission. © 2022

articleTitle: Autonomous and Generalized Soft Failure Detection based on Digital Residual Spectrum in Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose and experimentally demonstrate an autonomous and generalized soft failure detection scheme using Auto-Encoder and digital residual spectrum. False negative rate (FNR) for five transmission systems is below 3.87% with the same trained model.

articleTitle: Neural Network-Enhanced Optical Phase Conjugation for Nonlinearity Mitigation
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Using a multi-layer perceptron to equalise the residual nonlinearity from the transmission of PDM 28 Gbaud 64QAM over 400km of SSMF employing midlink optical phase conjugation, we demonstrate 12-fold reduction in the BER. © 2021 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Probabilistic Constellation Shaping: An Implementation Perspective
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This tutorial reviews recent advances in probabilistic constellation shaping (PCS) with particular focus on implementation perspectives. We analyze the complexity of several known shaping methods and discuss performance and complexity tradeoffs in different application scenarios.

articleTitle: OSNR-Aware Digital Pre-Emphasis for High Baudrate Coherent Optical Transmissions
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We derive and experimentally verify an analytical expression for adaptive digital pre-emphasis in coherent optical transmission systems with severe bandwidth limitation by considering both the transmitter response and optical link OSNR.

articleTitle: Method of Estimating Inter-Core Crosstalk for Constructing Uncoupled Multi-Core Fiber Transmission Line
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose and experimentally demonstrate a method based on optical time domain reflectometry for evaluating splices in terms of ensuring the total end-to-end inter-core crosstalk of transmission lines consisting of uncoupled multi-core fibers. © 2021 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Recent Advances in Large-scale Optical Switches Based on Silicon Photonics
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We review our recent results in multi-port strictly non-blocking silicon photonics switches. Challenges for polarization and wavelength insensitive operations are discussed. These results indicate the Si-photonics switch is suitable for the data center network applications. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Digital Subcarriers: A Universal Technology for Next Generation Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Coherent technology can be operated with independent digital subcarriers to realize point-to-point and point-to-multipoint optical networks. Enabled by configurable software management, it creates a simple, scalable, low-cost solution, compatible across network, vendors, and generations. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Transoceanic Phase and Polarization Fiber Sensing using Real-Time Coherent Transceiver
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We implement a real-time coherent transceiver with fast streaming outputs for environmental sensing. Continuous sensing using phase and equalizer outputs over 12800 km of submarine cable enabled time resolved interferometry in broad spectral range of 10mHz-1 kHz. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Advanced Fiber Sensing Leveraging Coherent Systems Technology for Smart Network Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We show that coherent technology developed in the past decade for transmission over core optical networks can benefit to Distributed Fiber Sensing technology in various fields as sensitivity, sensing range, and coexistence with data traffic. ©2021 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Employing Fiber Sensing and On-Premise AI Solutions for Cable Safety Protection over Telecom Infrastructure
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We review the distributed-fiber-sensing field trial results over deployed telecom networks. With local AI processing, real-time detection, and localization of abnormal events with cable damage threat assessment are realized for cable self-protection. © 2021

articleTitle: Role of Analogue Radio-over-Fibre Technology Beyond 5G
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Photonics-based mm-wave communication systems employing optical heterodyning can enable high-capacity wireless networks for systems beyond 5G. This work presents photonic, optoelectronic and signal processing technologies to overcome phase/frequency noise issues associated with photonics-based mm-wave systems.

articleTitle: Polarization Insensitive Fiber Optic Parametric Amplifier with a Gain Bandwidth of 22 nm in S-Band
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a polarization insensitive fiber optic parametric amplifier to provide net gain > 10dB and polarization dependent gain <1dB for up to 19 WDM channels in the range 1508- 1530nm. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Implementation of Digital Chaotic Encryption in THz Wireless Communication
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We implement a digital chaos-based encryption scheme in a photonics-aided terahertz radio-over-fiber (ROF) system operating at 340 GHz. The encrypted PS-64QAM-OFDM signal is successfully transmitted over 20 km SSMF and 54 m wireless link. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: High Speed RGB Visible Light Communication (VLC) Using Digital Power-Domain Multiplexing (DPDM) of Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexed (OFDM) Signals
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a record 21 red-green-blue (RGB) laser-diode (LD) visible-light-communication (VLC) using digital-power-domain-multiplexing (DPDM) of orthogonal- frequency-division-multiplexed (OFDM) signals. 21.01-Gbit/s RGB DPDM -OFDM VLC transmission is achieved. © 2022 Author(s)

articleTitle: Computationally Efficient Pre-Distortion based on Adaptive Partitioning Neural Network in Underwater Visible Light Communication
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We proposed a computationally efficient pre-distortion scheme based on adaptive partitioning neural network to mitigate nonlinear impairments in high-speed UVLC system. We demonstrated a 56.3% computational complexity reduction in 2.85Gbit/s 64QAM-CAP UVLC system. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: High-temperature error-free operation in a heterogeneous silicon quantum dot comb laser
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We show error-free operation in over 40 comb lines from a heterogeneous silicon comb laser operating continuous-wave at a substrate temperature of 50°C. Such devices are attractive sources for optical interconnects in next-generation HPC systems.

articleTitle: Graph Sequence Attention Network-Enabled Reinforcement Learning for Time-Aware Robust Routing in OSU-Based OTN
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a time-aware robust routing in OSU -based OTN through the newly designed graph sequence attention network-enabled reinforcement learning. Simulation results show> 28% OSU frame loss reduction compared to the baselines. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Distributed Acoustic Sensing for Datacenter Optical Interconnects using Self-Homodyne Coherent Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) over a bidirectional datacenter link which uses self-homodyne coherent detection for the data signal. Frequency multiplexing allows sharing the optoelectronic hardware, and enables DAS as an auxiliary function. © 2021

articleTitle: 927-km End-to-End Interoperable 400-GbEthernet Optical Communications through 2-km 400GBASE-FR4, 8×100-km 400G-OpenROADM and 125-km 400-ZR Fiber Lines
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: For the first time, we report an end-to-end interoperable optical transmission of 400-GbE data flows on 927-km through 2-km 400GBASE-FR4, 8×100-km 400G-OpenROADM and 125-km 400-ZR fiber line sections that use the latest developed 400G QSFP-DD and CFP2 optics. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Highly Reliable 106 Gb/s PAM-4 850 nm Multi-Mode VCSEL for 800G Ethernet Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This paper reviews II-VI's 106 Gb/s PAM-4 multi-mode VCSELs for commercial 800G transceiver applications. The VCSEL provides 27 GHz bandwidth, RIN of −150 dB/Hz, 0.25 nm spectral width and shows an excellent reliability. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: ANN-based Optimization of Probabilistic and Geometric Shaping for Flexible Rate 50G and beyond PON
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Joint probabilistic and geometric shaping is considered for flexible PON. Optimal modulation is found through ANN, which generalizes to various ROPs and fiber lengths while taking dispersion, limited bandwidth, and receiver-side DSP into account. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: 72.64 Tb/s DWDM Transmission over 100 km G.654D Fiber Using Super C-Band Erbium-Doped Fiber Amplification
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report a record of 72.64 Tb/s WDM transmission at 12.29 bits/s/Hz over 100 km G.654D fiber. Super C-band EDFAs with 6 THz gain spectrum are used to transmit 43 130 GBaud DP-PCS256QAM channels. © OFC 2022 The Authors.

articleTitle: High Information Rate of 128-GBaud 1.8-Tb/s and 64-GBaud 1.03-Tb/s Signal Generation and Detection Using Frequency-Domain 8×2 MIMO Equalization
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate 1-Tb/s and 1.8-Tb/s net rate signals with 16- and 14-bit/4Dsymbol information rates at 64 and 128 GBaud by precisely equalizing transmitter- and receiver-side imperfections with frequency-domain 8×2 MIMO linear equalization and nonlinear pre-distortion. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Over-67-GHz-bandwidth Membrane InGaAlAs EADFB Laser on Si Platform
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A membrane InGaAlAs electro-absorption modulator with an over 67-GHz bandwidth is integrated with a DFB laser on a Si platform. The integrated device shows a dynamic extinction ratio of 3.8 dB for 100-Gbit/s non-return-to-zero signals. © 2021 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Photonic Tensor Core with Photonic Compute-in-Memory
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Here we demonstrate a photonic tensor core based on a silicon photonics dot-product engine. Utilizing compact electronic phase-change-material based photonic memory and WDM we show the highest throughput density to date of 3.8 MAC/s/mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Machine Learning Based EDFA Channel In-band Gain Ripple Modeling
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: For the first time, a framework is proposed to model EDFA's channel in-band gain ripple by machine learning. The achieved model accuracy (standard deviation) is 0.022dB/nm for gain tilt and 0.053dB for overall gain. © 2021 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Dynamic Quantum Network: from Quantum Data Centre to Quantum Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This paper presents challenges and solutions for creating a dynamic entangled quantum network as the main technology enabler for realizing scalable quantum data centres and future quantum cloud computing infrastructure serving a large number of users.

articleTitle: Enabling Router Bypass and Saving Cost using Point-to-Multipoint Transceivers for Traffic Aggregation
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose combining point-to-multipoint coherent transceivers with a hybrid ROADM/filterless line system to enable a flatter IP-architecture for cost-effectively scaling metro-core/access networks. Considering various traffic and link engineering scenarios, we show CAPEX savings exceeding 40%. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: End-to-End Learning of Joint Geometric and Probabilistic Constellation Shaping
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present a novel autoencoder-based learning of joint geometric and probabilistic constellation shaping for coded-modulation systems. It can maximize either the mutual information (for symbol-metric decoding) or the generalized mutual information (for bit-metric decoding). © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Real-Time Transmission over 2×55 km All 7-Core Coupled-Core Multi-Core Fiber Link
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate the first transmission experiment using 7-core coupled-core fiber with in-line coupled-core multi-core amplifiers and real-time DSP. The real-time DSP is implemented using a single FPGA that performs MIMO processing across all 7 cores. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Path-Independent Insertion-Loss (PILOSS) 8 × 8 Silicon Photonics Switch with <8 nsec Switching Time
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate strictly non-blocking and 8 × 8 silicon photonics switch with 10-90% switching time of <8 nsec, on-chip loss of 3.8±0.19 dB independent of path settings, and 20-dB crosstalk bandwidth of ~30 nm. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Investigation of Wideband Distributed Raman Amplification in a Few-Mode Fiber Link
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally investigate distributed Raman amplification in a graded-index three-mode fiber over more than 80 nm signal bandwidth. We measured gain of up to 6 dB with 0.3 dB mode-dependence when pumping only the highest-order modes. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Shaped Four-Dimensional Modulation Formats for Optical Fiber Communication Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We review the design of multidimensional modulations by maximizing generalized mutual information and compare the maximum transmission reach of recently introduced 4D formats. A model-based optimization for nonlinear-tolerant 4D modulations is also discussed. © 2021 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Ultralow-Loss, Plug-and-Play Hollow-Core Fiber Interconnection
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: An ultralow-loss, plug-and-play single-mode hollow-core fiber (HCF) connector is developed. Insertion loss of 0.13 dB and 0.10 dB for HCF to itself @1550 nm and to a standard single-mode fiber @1489 nm, respectively, is demonstrated.

articleTitle: An Error Compensation Method of Time Synchronization for Cross-domain Interconnection in SD-TSN
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a time synchronization modeling and error compensation method for Software-Defined TSN. Experiments verify that the combination method of POE and NNPID can effectively improve time synchronization performance in SD-TSN for cross-domain interconnection.

articleTitle: Capacity Maximization of Power-constrained Submarine Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We review a novel semi-analytical approach to the achievable information rate maximization of submarine links with gain-shaped EDFAs, and provide the optimal pre-emphasis in presence of both amplified noise and fiber nonlinearity. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Intelligent End-to-End Nonlinear Constellation Auto-Optimization in W-band Fiber-MMW Integrated Transmission for 6G Access
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose and experimentally demonstrate an intelligent end-to-end nonlinear constellation auto-optimization method for fiber-MMW integrated 6G access network. Up to 60% lower bit-error-rate compared with the conventional constellation is achieved at 50-Gbps W-band fiber-MMW access. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Silica-PLC based mode-dependent-loss equalizer for two LP mode transmission
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A mode-dependent-loss (MDL) equalizer based on silica-PLC is proposed for three-mode transmission and experimentally demonstrated for the first time. By selectively attenuating LP<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">01</inf>-mode, 1.5-dB MDL equalization is demonstrated for the setup with large LP<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</inf>-mode loss. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Enhanced backscatter fibers for sensing in telecom networks
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We discuss the application of enhanced backscattering fiber in telecom networks. Such fibers can greatly increase the potential of telecom networks to be used as sensors of network health and its surrounding environment. © 2021 Optica

articleTitle: Modulation Format Aggregation of Nyquist channels by Spectral Superposition with Electro-Optic Modulators
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose and experimentally demonstrate a new scheme for all-optical coherent modulation format conversion based on vector summation facilitated by coherent spectral superposition with an electro-optic modulator without using any optical nonlinearity. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: DSP Enabled Next Generation Flexible PON for 50G and Beyond
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: In fiber access, DSP is used for the first time in the ITU-T 50G-PON. Here, we review the benefits of DSP in enabling more flexible PON systems today with 50G-PON and into the future. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Datacenter-Carrier Cooperation over Optical Networks during Disaster Recovery
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A novel cooperation strategy among DC service provider and carriers (operating optical networks) is proposed for disaster recovery. This cooperation improves service restoration by 70% w.r.t. benchmark methods for typical scenarios. with reduced cost. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: All-fiber noise-mitigating sampling of temporal waveforms enabling broadband operation and high passive amplification
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose an all-fiber design concept for Talbot-based denoising passive enhancement of temporal waveforms using four-wave-mixing, and demonstrate about an order-of-magnitude improvement in the operation bandwidth × amplification factor (> 150 GHz) versus previous electrooptic designs.

articleTitle: Scalable On-Chip Single-Photon Cross-Bar Switching
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Single-photon measurements of an electro-optic silicon-photonic add-drop microresonator demonstrate entanglement-preserving voltage-driven switching with fast 10%-90% transition times [<50 ps], low-loss transmission [94% (90%) bar (cross)-state] and high quantum two-photon interference visibility [~99%] at 1550 nm.

articleTitle: High-Capacity Mode Division Multiplexing Transmission Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Mode division multiplexing is an attractive method of increasing the transmission capacity. This paper presents the 402.7-Tbit/s weakly coupled 10-mode-multiplexed transmission over 48 km and 50.47-Tbit/s standard cladding coupled 4-core fiber transmission over 9,150 km. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Non-Linear Effects of WDM Transmission versus Optical Routing Impairments: Does One Prevail at Network Level?
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The influence on network performance of WDM transmission non-linear effects is compared to the impact of optical filtering and crosstalk induced by the wavelength routing cross-connects, for 3 network topologies and 2 distinct transponder technologies © 2022 Nokia

articleTitle: Comparison of Different Deformation Functions Modeling Micro-bending Loss of Optical Fibers on Sandpaper Test
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Different deformation functions to find the best fit to the experimental data of micro-bending loss measurements of optical fibers are investigated. Best outcome, fitting the parameters is in the form of a Gaussian power spectrum. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Reduced-Coated Fibers and Micro-Duct Cables
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We investigate the cable miniaturizations and densities enabled by 180µm-coated fibers with standard 125µm cladding. We then explore the possibility to reduce the coating diameter down to 165µm while keeping a standard 125 µm cladding. ©2022 The Authors.

articleTitle: >87% Complexity Reduction at 25-GS/s, 50-Gbps and 30-dB Loss Budget LR-OFDM PON using Digital Predistortion
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate the digital predistortion (DPD) at a reduced sampling rate in high-loss-budget 10G-class LR-PONs. <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{A} > 50$</tex>-Gbps transmission was achieved over 30–70 km using fixed DPD with >87% complexity reduction, compared to fully optimized DPD. © 2021 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Realization of EML Submodule for 100-Gbaud Operation Using LC Resonance with Optimization of Load Resistance
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: By using LC resonance effect with optimization of load resistance, the 3-dB bandwidth of a lumped-EML submodule can be enhanced to > 55 GHz although an EAM length is 150 um, making it enable 100-Gbaud operations. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: 106-Gb/s Waveguide AlInAs/GaInAs Avalanche Photodiode with Butt-joint Coupling Structure
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A waveguide AIInAs/GaInAs APD with the butt-joint coupling structure for 106-Gb/s PAM4 applications is demonstrated for the first time. A maximum 3-dB bandwidth of 38 GHz and high responsivity at unity gain of 0.90 A/W are exhibited at 1.55 µm. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Caching with light: First demonstration of an Optical Cache Memory Prototype
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: An optical cache memory prototype is experimentally presented for the first time featuring 8-bit storage capability. It employs a 4×2 optical RAM bank relying on 5Gb/s monolithic InP Flip-Flops, an optical Tag comparator and all-passive Row/Column Decoding circuits.

articleTitle: A Simple and Accurate Method to Estimate the Nonlinear Performance of VCSEL IM-DD System
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrated that, for VCSEL IM-DD systems, spectrum of nonlinear distortion can be accurately measured by adding frequency-domain notch, even the stimulus is non-Gaussian. With measured spectrum, nonlinear performance was estimated accurately. © 2021 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Real Time 6.4 Tbps (8×800G) SHCD Transmission through 1+8 Multicore Fiber for Co-Packaged Optical-IO Switch Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We successfully demonstrated a real time 6.4Tbps self-homodyne coherent transmissions without polarization tracking through specially designed 10km multi-core fibers with 1 polarization maintaining core and 8 normal single-mode cores, using the wavelength unlocked DFB laser.

articleTitle: Mobile 14-GHz Bandwidth Fronthaul Link Supporting 128 RF-Chain Signals for 6G Ma-MIMO Beamforming
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate fronthual links with delay-division-multiplexing 14-GHz bandwidth 64-QAM OFDM for 128 RF-chain signals. The corresponding CPRI-based capacity is 860.16 Gb/s. With I/Q Volterra nonlinear compensation, EVMs can be improved from 7.5% to 6%.

articleTitle: 1060nm Single-mode Transverse Coupled Cavity VCSEL with Surface Relief Engineering for 80Gbps PAM4 Modulation
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate l060nm VCSELs with surface relief engineering, providing transverse-resonance in transverse-coupled cavity VCSELs, which enables single-mode operation and bandwidth enhancement. We obtained a large signal modulation of 54 Gbps NRZ and 80 Gbps PAM4.

articleTitle: Real-time In-field Automatic Bias Control and Self-calibration Module for High-baud Coherent Driver Modulator
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report a real-time in-field low-cost module that can simultaneously realize self-calibration and automatic-bias-control for coherent driver modulators. Precise frequency-response (<0.5dB) and IQ skew (<0.2ps) correction are achieved in experiments of 25/20GBaud 16/64QAM signal transmissions.

articleTitle: 288 Gb/s 850 nm VCSEL-based Interconnect over 100 m MMF based on Feature-enhanced Recurrent Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate an ultra-high speed record of single-lane 288 Gb/s PAM-8 signal transmission over 100 m MMF attributed to the proposed design-optimized 850 nm VCSEL and feature-enhanced RNN equalization. © 2021 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Non-intrusive and Highly Sensitive Gas Flow Monitoring based on Distributed Acoustic Sensing
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a non-intrusive pipeline flow monitoring system based on the DAS. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first time a DAS system has been used for gas flow monitoring. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: On the Application of Explainable Artificial Intelligence to Lightpath QoT Estimation
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate the potentialities of explainable AI when applied to distill knowledge from a trained supervised machine learning model for lightpath quality of transmission estimation in optical networks, with synthetic datasets. © 2021 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Latency-aware network architectures for 5G backhaul and fronthaul
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: 5G poses important challenges regarding latency management, specially in fronthaul and backhaul traffic transport. Operators are combining standards in search of a unified architecture that features virtualization, programmability and performance control. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: 180 GBd Electronic-Plasmonic IC Transmitter
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A monolithically integrated plasmonic SiGe-BiCMOS electronic transmitter operating at 180 GBd is demonstrated. Such compact high-speed electronic-photonic integrated circuit (EPIC) transmitters are key components for future high-performance computing (HPC) and data center interconnects (DCI). © 2021 OCIS Codes: 130.4110, 130.3120

articleTitle: Highly-reflective facet-coated 16-wavelength DFB laser array with exact wavelength spacings
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: An HR-AR-coated sixteen-wavelength DFB laser array is experimentally demonstrated with exact wavelength spacings. The spacing accuracy is preliminary guaranteed by the reconstruction-equivalent-chirp technique. The further exact wavelength spacing is achieved by distributed phase compensation.

articleTitle: 200-Gb/s/λ Coherent TDM-PON with Wide Dynamic Range of >30-dB based on Local Oscillator Power Adjustment
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the 200-Gb/s/λ PDM-16QAM coherent TDM-PON data transmission with wide dynamic-range based on the local-oscillator power adjustment for continuous and burst-mode signals, achieving >30-dB dynamic-range and 37-dB power budget over 50-km SSMF transmission. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: qTReX: A semi-autonomous continuous-variable quantum key distribution system
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Continuous-variable quantum cryptography can leverage existing telecommunication technology for solving the cryptographic task of secure key distribution. We present qTReX: A low-noise, highly stable, semi-autonomous prototype using optical coherent states for quantum key distribution. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: DeepALM: Holistic Optical Network Monitoring based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a machine learning-based optical network monitoring system which can integrate fiber monitoring, predictive maintenance of optical hardware, and security information management in a single solution. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: 64-Channel WDM Transmitter based on Optical Fourier Transformation using a Portable Time Lens Assembly
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate 64-WDM-channel generation with 25-GHz spacing from a single SFP+ transceiver using a portable time lens optical processor. After transmission in a 50-km unamplified link, −39.1 dBm average received power sensitivity at <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{BER}=10^{-3}$</tex> is measured. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Simple and ultrafast automatic bias control for optical IQ modulators enabled by dither vector mapping monitoring
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A simple and ultrafast automatic bias control for optical IQ modulators is proposed using dither-vector-mapping monitoring. It is verified in 40/20Gbaud 16/64QAM signal transmissions, and the tracking time (0.3~0.5s) is 30-times faster than commercial products.

articleTitle: Demonstration of 128×100-Gb/s Real-Time Coherent UDWDM-PON with >35-dB Power Budget
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a coherent UDWDM-PON scheme and experimentally demonstrate a real-time 128×100-Gb/s downlink coherent UDWDM-PON at 37.5-GHz channel spacing. The power budget can achieve more than 35 dB after 48-km SSMF transmission. OCIS codes: (060.1660) Coherent communications; (060.2230) Fiber optics communications

articleTitle: Low-cost Asymmetric Point-to-multipoint Coherent Architecture for Access Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a low-cost asymmetric point-to-multipoint coherent architecture for access networks. In this architecture, the coherent transmitters for the unlink are greatly simplified and the tolerance to laser frequency offset is significantly improved. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Probabilistic vs. Geometric Constellation Shaping in Commercial Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We discuss performance and implementation aspects of geometric and probabilistic constellation shaping, which can be optimized for different applications. We show that symbol rate optimization with probabilistic shaping can further improve reach/capacity.

articleTitle: A Dynamically Reconfigurable Optical Switching Node for Hybrid Analog/Digital RoF Transport
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a dynamically reconfigurable optical switching node interconnecting both Digital and Analog RoF interfaces. Successful optical/wireless transmission is verified, and real-world services are showcased over the deployed WDM infrastructure. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Ultra-low loss silicon nitride ring modulator with low power PZT actuation for photonic control
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A wafer-scale PZT-actuated ultra-low loss, low-power, stress-optic Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> ring modulator is realized with 7 million Q, 0.03 dB/cm loss, 20 nW power consumption and 20 MHz 3-dB bandwidth, is demonstrated to track a laser. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Tutorial: Evolution of Machine Learning in Optical Access Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This tutorial will provide a comprehensive review of the evolution of machine learning in optical access networks, from drivers, supporting technologies, through to novel applications and new use cases.

articleTitle: Up to 600 Gbit/s data transmission over 100 m of single multi-mode fiber using 4×λ 850–940 nm VCSELs
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate parallel high speed data transmission over single multimode fiber using VCSELs operating in the SWDM wavelength range (850 nm – 940 nm). Total demonstrated throughput of such system reaches 500 Gbit/s with 4-PAM modulation and 600 Gbit/s with DMT modulation.

articleTitle: Uncooled 100 GBd O-Band EML for Datacom Transmitter Arrays
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: 100 GBd is demonstrated from 30°C to 70°C with O-Band InP EML array chips. Modulation bandwidths are above 50 GHz, and an integrated SOA ensures 10 dBm, while a single active layer allows for cost effective manufacturing.

articleTitle: Link Tomography for Amplifier Gain Profile Estimation and Failure Detection in $\mathrm{C}+\mathrm{L}$-band Open Line Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a distance-wise, wavelength-dependent link tomography extraction scheme using receiver DSP. This approach permits the estimation of gain spectrum and tilt in <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{C}+\mathrm{L}$</tex>-band EDFAs with a maximum mean absolute error of 0.6 dB. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: First Demonstration of Crosstalk-Free (< −38.5 dB) 32-ch DWDM Demultiplexer on Standard Si PIC Platform
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Enabled by a fully integrated autonomous calibration mechanism, crosstalk-free 32-ch WDM demultiplexer on standard Si PIC platform is demonstrated for the first time. Compatible with the vast component libraries of standard Si PIC platform, this device provides a path to ultrahigh-capacity integrated DWDM transceivers. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Bringing 2-Phase Immersion Cooling to Hyperscale Cloud
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The advent of high-TDP chips is pushing cloud providers towards liquid cooling. Microsoft is advancing and deploying 2-phase immersion cooling in Azure. We discuss the trends, the challenges, and the opportunities in this space. © 2022 Ashish Raniwala

articleTitle: A hybrid-integrated external cavity laser with ultra-wide wavelength tuning range and high side-mode suppression
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present a III-V/Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> hybrid-integrated tunable laser. The laser shows a record of ~170-nm tuning range with a side mode suppression ratio above 64 dB and an intrinsic linewidth below 2.8 kHz. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: THz Transport Technologies and Strategists Beyond 5G/6G Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Utilization of THz wave is being considered to achieve the target expected for 6<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> Generation Mobile Communication System (6G). The research topics and considerations how to use the bands in 6G era is addressed.

articleTitle: Random Number Generation by Brillouin-enhanced Four-wave-mixing in Polarization Maintaining Fiber
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report a novel real-time true random number generator based on Brillouin-enhanced FWM. Random bit sequences produced from the idler's intensity fluctuation, due to position and time dependent stochastic birefringence changes, passed all NIST tests. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Agile Subsea Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Approaches to configurable optical routing including fiber switching and WSS spectrum routing have become ubiquitous in undersea transmission systems. These agile architectures must be reconsidered as the fiber pair count, fiber technology and branching node complexity of those systems continues to grow. ©2022 The Author(s).

articleTitle: Efficient Training of Volterra Series-Based Pre-distortion Filter Using Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present a simple, efficient “direct learning” approach to train Volterra series-based digital pre-distortion filters using neural networks. We show its superior performance over conventional training methods using a 64-QAM 64 GBaud simulated transmitter with varying transmitter nonlinearity and noisy conditions. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: High Performance Avalanche Photodiode in a Monolithic Silicon Photonics Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a waveguide-integrated germanium-on-silicon avalanche photodiode in a monolithic silicon photonics technology, with TE responsivity of 26 A/W at 1310 nm wavelength at −5 V operating bias with a 3-dB bandwidth of > 30 GHz. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Hybrid Polymer THz Receiver PIC with Waveguide Integrated Photoconductive Antenna: Concept and 1st Characterization Results
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: An all-photonic THz-receiver PIC comprising an on-chip frequency stabilization scheme and a novel InP-based photoconductive antenna is presented. Characterization of the key photonic building blocks shows the functionality of the PIC. © 2022 The Authors

articleTitle: Passive Nonlinear Compensation Circuits for Photovoltaic Visible Light Communications under Low Illuminance
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: For photovoltaic nonlinearity, the distortion is much exacerbated at a low illumination level. We propose and experimentally demonstrate a simple passive post-distortion compensation circuit without complex DSP and achieve one-order of magnitude reduction in BER. OCIS codes: (060.2605) Free-space optical communication; (040.5350) Photovoltaic; (040.3780) Low light level

articleTitle: PON Virtualization Including PHY Softwarization
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This paper summarizes studies on passive optical network (PON) virtualization, including the softwarization of physical-layer (PHY) coding and digital signal processing (DSP), as well as PON abstraction, which provide flexibility and agility to access networks. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Transmission of 400GBASE-LR8 Over 15 km Deployed Step-Index 4-Core fiber for Data Centre Interconnects
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate transmission of 400GBASE-LR8 signals over 15 km of in-stalled simple step-index 4-core fiber. Resultant symbol error rate was below the KP4-FEC threshold showing the suitability of multicore fibers as data centre interconnects. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Ultra-Low-Loss MCF Fanouts for Submarine SDM Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: MCFs have been developed for submarine deployment. Reliability and insertion loss are gating factors for this demanding application. Here we demonstrate a 0.15-dB-loss fanout, which is fusion spliced to a pure-silica two-core submarine-grade MCF.

articleTitle: 4-antenna Distributed Receiving System for Broadband Signal Transmission and Combination
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a stable distributed receiving antenna system for broadband signal transmission and combination. A simple remote structure, a large link compensation range, and improved signal SNR have been achieved simultaneously with 4 remote ends.

articleTitle: Integrated 1.58 cm range Resolution Radar and 60 Gbit/s 50m Wireless Communication Based-on Photonics technology in Terahertz Band
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A novel photonics-based THz band high-resolution radar sensing, and a long-distance communication system integrated architecture was proposed and experimentally demonstrated. To the best of our knowledge, 60 Gbit/s THz signals at 340 GHz band were delivered over 50 m wireless distance with an integrated 1.58 cm resolution radar for the first time. © 2022 The Author(s).

articleTitle: Experimental Investigation of Influence of SOA-Induced Nonlinear Distortion on High-Symbol-Rate 168-GBaud Signal for Achieving Ultra-Broadband Optical Frontend
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a transmitter configuration using an ultra-broadband optical frontend integrated with a bandwidth multiplexer and SOA. Experiments demonstrate the SOA-induced nonlinear distortion slightly affects (< 1-dB SNR degradation) the 1-Tb/s 168-GBaud signal using AMUX-integrated frontend. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Photonic Integrated Unitary Processor based on Multi-Plane Light Conversion
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Recent progress of developing universal optical unitary processors (OUPs) based on the concept of multi-plane light conversion (MPLC) is reviewed. The inherent redundancy of MPLC provides unique scalability and excellent robustness against fabrication imperfectness, enabling large-scale OUPs integrated on silicon and InP platforms. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: GI-core Multimode and Single-mode Polymer Waveguides for High-density Co-packaging
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present unique polymer optical waveguide coupler devices fabricated using the Mosquito method to apply for adiabatic coupling with Si photonics chips, three-dimensional fan-in/fan-out devices for multicore fibers, and MUX devices for mode division multiplexing.

articleTitle: Dimensional Variation Tolerant Inverse Designed Broadband Mode Converter
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report on a low-loss (<1dB) TE1-TE3 mode converter, robust to ±10 nm etch-errors, operating over a wavelength range of 1.5-1.58 µm with modal crosstalk below −20dB. 20 GBaud PAM-4 signal transmission validates the conversion.

articleTitle: Traffic Monitoring System for 100-Gbps Virtualized Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a system to get flow information of virtualized logical networks in support of 100-Gbps optical networks. By using packet sampling, we can create monitoring rules even when the monitoring target is unknown.

articleTitle: Self-tuning quantum key distribution transmitter based on a genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a self-tuning QKD transmitter by employing a genetic algorithm for automated optimisation. Without user intervention, laser parameters are determined automatically to minimise quantum bit error rates to similar levels achieved by QKD specialists. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Suppression of Spurious Mixing in FWM-based Systems through Mid-Span Pump Phase Shift
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a new technique to suppress spurious idler generation during four-wave mixing, by applying a π radian phase shift to the pumps at the mid-point of the processing medium.

articleTitle: Terahertz Band Data Communications using Dielectric Rod Waveguide
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A terahertz data link is presented using dielectric rod waveguide (DRW) at 300 GHz and complex modulations for speeds up to 120 Gbps. Performance comparison with WR-3 rectangular waveguide validates the low-dispersion behaviour of DRW. © 2022 The Authors.

articleTitle: Demonstration of Industrial-grade Passive Optical Network
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a TDM-PON operating according to industrial-grade standards. Using a suitably configured PON-MAC and jitter compensation we achieved constant low latency upstream transmission and successful interworking with a TSN network and time-critical flows.

articleTitle: Autonomous Pulse Control for Quantum Transducers with Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Quantum transducers are the back-bone technology and enabler for the Quantum Internet. We created a Deep Reinforcment Learning control framework to overcome current, low conversion efficiencies, bringing quantum transducers towards practical use. © 2021 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Fast-response, energy-efficient thermo-optic silicon phase shifter based on non-Hermitian engineering
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present a fast response, energy-efficient thermo-optic silicon phase shifter based on Non-Hermitian engineering. A 729 kHz bandwidth and an 11.3 mW π-phase-shift (Pπ) power consumption are demonstrated at 1550 nm wavelength.

articleTitle: Partial Response O-band EML Transmission Beyond 300-GBd with a 128/256 GSa/s DAC
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally compared 128 and 256-GSa/s DACs using partial response signaling. Transmission of 310-GBd OOK is demonstrated with a single 128 GSa/s DAC for up to 5-km without optical amplification (net 268.84Gb/s, AIR ≈ 300Gb/s). © 2021 The Authors

articleTitle: 50 Gbaud QPSK E-band Transmission Using Bismuth Doped Fiber Amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate 35nm E-band transmission through 60km SSMF using 50Gbaud QPSK signals with Q<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> factor penalties less than 2.75dB enabled by a bismuth doped fiber amplifier with 29.8dB gain and 6.25dB noise figure. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: On the Robustness of a ML-based Method for QoT Tool Parameter Refinement in Partially Loaded Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The robustness of a ML-based QoT input parameters refinement technique in partially loaded networks (both static and dynamic) is assessed using experimental data. SNR prediction error is reduced by up to 1dB over >40000 services. © 2021 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Broadband, Low-Crosstalk and Power-Efficient $32\times 32$ Optical Switch on a Dual-Layer Si3N4-on-SOI Platform
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$32\times 32$</tex> optical switch on a dual-layer Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>-on-SOI platform with low fiber-to-fiber insertion loss (9.61∼14.51 dB), low crosstalk (∼35 dB), broad 3-dB bandwidth (∼57 nm) and low power consumption (∼0.83 W). © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: High-performance and Ultra-compact Endless Automatic Polarization Controller based on Thin-film Lithium Niobate
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Based on thin-film lithium niobate platform, we experimentally demonstrate an endless automatic polarization controller which only requires a driving voltage range of 10 V, and achieves a polarization tracking speed of 10 Krad/s. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Demonstration and Trial of a new CWDM and Circulator integrated semi-active system for 5G fronthual
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a new CWDM and Circulator integrated semi-active system for 5G fronthaul, and key test data. The system can support 6-channel 25 Gbit/s fronthaul channel capability, and support protection switching function, real-time signal power of multiple working wavelengths Online detection function, and reflected interference signal power detection function.

articleTitle: Development of Low-power Coherent ASIC
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The latest generation of coherent pluggable modules impose strict power limits on the coherent ASIC. The development process for a low-power coherent ASIC designed in a 7nm FINFET process is described. The ASIC enables pluggable coherent modules with energy efficiency of 40-60pJ/bit for various 400G DWDM applications. © 2022

articleTitle: Real-time 100 Gb/s IM/DD DMT with Chirp Managed Laser Supporting 400 Gb/ CWDM-4 over 20 km
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate the first real-time 100 Gb/s IM/DD DMT transmission with a chirp managed laser over − 65.6 ps/nm to + 48.6 ps/nm of dispersion which is sufficient to support 400 Gb/s CWDM-4 transmission over 20 km.

articleTitle: Photonic Interferometric Imager with monolithic silicon CMOS photonic integrated circuits
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate, for the first time to our knowledge, a monolithically-integrated photonic interferometric imager circuit with on-chip detectors, CMOS trans-impedance-amplifiers, and associated photonic imager components. A proof-of-principle demonstration of interferogram fringe generation will be discussed. © 2022 The Authors

articleTitle: Development and Modeling of Ge-free Microring Avalanche Photodiode in Optical Communication Band
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A physical model was developed to unfold different optical absorption mechanisms in a Germanium-free microring avalanche photodiode. Fabricated pure-Silicon microring detector showed competitive performance to support 100 Gb/s PAM4 operations at O-band. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: 850 nm hybrid-integrated tunable laser with Si3N4 micro-ring resonator feedback circuits
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A novel hybrid integrated tunable laser at 850 nm wavelength has been demonstrated, with a tuning range of >50 nm, an intrinsic linewidth <600 Hz and optical output power of 7.5 dBm.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Pre-Distortion in DML-based OFDM Transmission Enabled by Low-Complexity Sparse Volterra Filtering
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A nonlinear pre-distorter is proposed in DML-based OFDM transmission. The complexity of pre-distorter is reduced by > 90% using the ℓ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf>-regularization, ℓ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf>- regularization, or re-orthogonalization, and the data rate is still increased by > 50% after >150-km fiber. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Microservice-Based Unsupervised Anomaly Detection Loop for Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Unsupervised learning (UL) is a technique to detect previously unseen anomalies without needing labeled datasets. We propose the integration of a scalable UL-based inference component in the monitoring loop of an SDN-controlled optical network. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Integrated Optical Phased Arrays for Augmented Reality, LiDAR, and Beyond
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Recent integrated optical phased array architectures, results, and applications will be reviewed, including beam steering for LiDAR and communications, near-field optical manipulation, and holographic displays for augmented reality. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Sub-10 kHz Intrinsic Linewidth Extended Cavity DBR laser on InP Generic Foundry Platform
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report an extended-cavity DBR laser with an intrinsic linewidth of 10 kHz and an output power of ~18 mW at an injection current of < 100 mA, on an InP generic foundry platform. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Wide-field-of-view Perovskite Quantum-dots Fibers Array for Easing Pointing, Acquisition and Tracking in Underwater Wireless Optical Communication
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrated, for the first time, perovskite quantum-dots optical fibers array successfully eases the pointing, acquisition and tracking requirement facing visible-laser-based underwater wireless optical communication. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Mismatch Length Estimation of Self-Homodyne Coherent Optical Systems by Using Carrier-Pilot-Assist Method
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The Self-Homodyne Coherent (SHC) is a promising solution for inter- or intra datacenter application in future. We proposed a carrier-pilot-assist (CPA) method to estimate mismatch length, which provides guidance for alleviating phase noise of SHC system. This method is robust and is independent of performance of DSP algorithm and IQ imbalance impairment.

articleTitle: Concatenated GSNR Profiles for End-to-End Performance Estimations in Disaggregated Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The performance of a wide-band optical spectrum service is computed using individual segment characterizations and compared to measured end-to-end performance. An accuracy of ±1.4 dB is achieved for live network routes up to 3116 km. © 2021 The Author(s).

articleTitle: Design Analysis of a High-Speed Directly Modulated Laser with Push-Pull Silicon Ring Modulators
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
