abstract: We design and analyze a novel high-speed directly-modulated laser combining a pair of push-pull ring modulators. The mechanism of push-pull modulators makes the laser immune to phase-change induced wavelength chirp and other cavity-related modulation penalties.

articleTitle: Hybrid InP-SiN microring-resonator based tunable laser with high output power and narrow linewidth for high capacity coherent systems
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A hybrid InP/SiN tunable laser based on microring resonators exhibiting 40mW fiber-coupled output power and 5kHz linewidth is demonstrated. The device shows performance comparable with commercial external cavity lasers in 90GBd 64QAM coherent system

articleTitle: Generation of Optical Frequency Comb via Cross-Phase Modulation in an SOI Waveguide
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Using temporal Talbot processing followed by cross-phase modulation in a silicon-on-insulator waveguide, we experimentally multiply the repetition rate of a 10-GHz optical pulse train and generate widely spaced optical frequency combs up to 50 GHz. © 2021 The Author(s)

articleTitle: ADMIRE: Demonstration of Collaborative Data-Driven and Model-Driven Intelligent Routing Engine for IP/Optical Cross-Layer Optimization in X-Haul Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We first demonstrate a collaborative data-driven (using deep reinforcement learning) and model-driven (using experience knowledge) routing engine for cross-layer optimization in a real X-Haul testbed with a real dataset, which achieves 23% wavelength saving. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Widely Tunable 1030 nm Gallium Arsenide Sampled Grating Distributed Bragg Reflector Lasers and Photonic Integrated Circuits
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A widely tunable 1030 nm gallium arsenide laser with an integrated semiconductor optical amplifier was demonstrated. Continuous tuning across 22.2 nm and up to 70 mW output power was achieved. © 2022 The Authors

articleTitle: Modified Weighted Learned Digital Backpropagation with Pre-optimization in High-symbol-rate Coherent Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A modified weighted learned digital backpropagation (M-W-LDBP) with pre-optimization is proposed for fiber nonlinearity compensation in high-symbol-rate coherent systems. Compared with LDBP, M-W-LDBP exhibits 1/0.7 dB signal-to-noise ratio gain in 90/128-GBaud systems, respectively. © 2021 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Surface Normal Electro-Absorption Modulators as Colorless Upstream Transmitters in a WDM Passive Optical Network
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a WDM passive optical network that uses high-speed, polarization-independent surface normal modulators as upstream 25-Gb/s transmitters. A band of CW wavelengths, sourced at the optical line terminal, establishes the upstream channels. System performance in our single-fiber architecture is limited by Rayleigh backscattering, but is below the FEC threshold.

articleTitle: Multi-Fiber Cylindrical Ferrule for Remote Rotary Optical Fiber Switching
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We devise a multi-fiber cylindrical ferrule for a rotary optical switch. We design the ferrule to achieve the equivalent loss to a conventional optical connector, and show the optical switching properties of the fabricated ferrule. © 2021 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Simplified TC-MLSE Equalizer for 210-Gb/s PAM-8 Signal Transmission in IM/DD Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose and experimentally demonstrate a trellis-compression MLSE in a 210-Gb/s PAM-8 signal transmission over 2-km SSFM transmission. We find TC-MLSE can reduce the complexity by 98% with only 0.2-dB penalty compared with conventional MLSE.

articleTitle: Liquid Waveguide Cladding for 2D Beam Steering of An Optical Phased Array at a Single Wavelength
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present the replacing of waveguide liquid claddings to implement 2D beam steering of an optical phased array. A maximum steering angle of> 10° was achieved with RI from 1.0 to 1.63 at 940 nm. © 2022 The Author(s).

articleTitle: Ultra-Low-Complexity MAP Demapper for Bandwidth-Limited Pluggable Coherent Optics beyond 800G
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We reveal the benefit of adding a MAP demapper in bandwidth-limited coherent systems, and study a simplified MAP algorithm achieving a comparable performance with the conventional MAP for 100-GBd 16/64-QAM with more than 8-fold complexity reduction. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: 11 Gb/s LWIR FSO Transmission at 9.6 µm using a Directly-Modulated Quantum Cascade Laser and an Uncooled Quantum Cascade Detector
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Record 11 Gb/s LWIR FSO transmission is demonstrated with a 9.6-µm directly-modulated QCL and a fully passive QCD without cooling, surpassing the previous bitrate record of DM-QCL-based FSO in this spectral window by 4 times. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: A fibre Bragg grating sensor-based instrumented glove for virtual rehabilitation applications
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A fibre Bragg grating sensor-based instrumented glove being developed for medical applications will be demonstrated that can be used to measure finger joint angles with a resolution of 0.1°. © 2021 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Elimination of the PMD Related Delay Jitter in an Ultra-Stable Microwave Signal Distribution System
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We realize an ultra-stable frequency signal distribution system. The relative delay jitter of the 24 GHz signal is only 13.0 fs after eliminating the PMD-related jitter originated from the stretching of the piezoelectric fiber stretcher.

articleTitle: “Digitalizing” Optical Layer for The Green Computing Continuum As The Future Digital Infrastructure
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This talk will review, from the perspective of photonics, the technological trends of the digital infrastructure migrating toward the “computing continuum,” where the optical network and computing infrastructure are converged. The functional block-based disaggregation (FBD) model will be introduced as a key to incorporate the optical layer switching into the future digital infrastructure. © 2022 The Authors

articleTitle: High-Capacity 400Gb/s Real-Time Transmission over SCUBA110 Fibers for DCI/Metro/Long-haul Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate real-time transmission 23.2 Tb/s (58x400Gb/s) DWDM signals over 1507km of G.654E SCUBA110 fiber using 400ZR+ pluggable coherent transceiver modules, additionally, 26Tb/s (65x400Gb/s) is transmitted over 200km SCUBA110 fiber link using 400ZR pluggable modules.

articleTitle: To Cooperate or Not to Cooperate: Service Function Chaining in Multi-Domain Edge-Cloud Elastic Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We study the the non-cooperative provisioning of service function chains in a multi-domain edge-cloud elastic optical network (EC-EON), leverage game theory to design an algorithm for it, and analyze its performance difference from the cooperative scheme with simulations.

articleTitle: Load-Balancing Routing Algorithm Against Inter-Satellite Link Congestion in LEO Satellite Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A novel load-balancing routing algorithm based on satellite-ground cooperation is proposed to reduce the impact of inter-satellite link congestion in LEO satellite optical networks. Simulations prove that our proposal can significantly improve the network throughput. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Compact adiabatic silicon photonic filters with arbitrary and ultra-broadband response
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present the design and experimental demonstration of compact silicon photonic filters through optimized fast adiabatic waveguides with arbitrarily wide bandwidths. Our devices achieve passbands up to 96.6 nm with flat-top and low-loss operation. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Techno-Economics of Terrestrial Extensions of Subsea Routes
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This paper investigates the benefit of using ultra-low-loss G.654.E fiber in the terrestrial section of PoP-PoP route in terms of GSNR improvement, higher fiber pair and cable capacity, and increased system value.

articleTitle: Semiconductor laser stabilized by a photonic integrated 4 meter coil-waveguide resonator
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We stabilize a semiconductor laser to a photonic-integrated, Si<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>, 4 meter coil resonator, achieving thermorefractive-noise-limited frequency noise. The laser exhibits a record low <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$87\ \text{Hz}\ 1/\pi$</tex> and 2.1 kHz <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\beta$</tex>-separation integral linewidth and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$2.6\times 10^{-13}$</tex> fractional frequency stability. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Wearable Smartwatch based on Optical Fiber for Continuous Blood Pressure Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present a wearable smartwatch based on optical fiber for continuous blood pressure monitoring. Clinical results show errors of systolic pressure and diastolic pressure are 0.93 ± 3.97 mmHg and −3.07 ± 2.69 mmHg. © 2021 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Low-loss Mode Field Adapter Using Reverse Tapering for Fundamental Mode Transmission over MMFs
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a low-loss mode field adapter based on reverse tapering for fundamental mode transmission in MMFs, which enables 7-dB MPI reduction and 2-dB Q factor improvement, compared with the center-launching situation. © 2022

articleTitle: Ultra-compact Multi-fiber Connector with Magnetic Physical Contact
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: An ultra-compact multi-fiber connector features a novel magnetic attraction structure for high-density on-board connector. The fabricated connectors show low-insertion losses comparable to those of conventional MPO connectors while achieving space-saving connection with an angled physical-contact. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Reduce Footprints of Multiport Interferometers by Cosine-Sine-Decomposition Unfolding
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present a novel 3D-unfolding method based on Cosine-Sine-Decomposition (CSD) to enable an alternative arrangement of unitary blocks towards plane normal, which reduces the planar footprints of universal multiport interferometers exponentially. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Generation and transmission of 160-Gbaud QPSK Coherent Signals using a Dual-Drive Plasmonic-Organic Hybrid I/Q modulator on Silicon Photonics
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report on coherent transmission of beyond 100 GBd signaling based on plasmonic technology. Using dual-drive plasmonic-organic-hybrid I/Q modulator on silicon photonics platform, we demonstrate the successful transmission of 160-GBaud QPSK and 140-GBaud 16QAM modulations.

articleTitle: Fiber-to-Application: Optical Slicing to Enhance Application Performance over a Metro Transport Network
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate the fiber-to-application transport slicing architecture and mechanism. The experiment shows ultrahigh throughput (> 5Gbps per application) and significant acceleration for 100 applications in 4 categories. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Optical Multi-Path Interference Noise Mitigation for 56 Gb/s PAM4 IMDD Transmission System
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate two multi-path-interference (MPI) mitigation algorithms that can effectively suppress the MPI noise in 56Gb/s PAM4 signal transmission over 15.5km SSMF system, under the signal-to-interference ratio of 18dB and laser linewidth of 4MHz.

articleTitle: Complex lasing based decentralized key distribution controlled by photothermal effect
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A logical-state fiber microcavity laser is proposed with random output spectrum controlled by photothermal effect. Combining the random and bistable features, decentralized key distribution is developed with functions of key generation/encryption at individual end-nodes. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Microscale mode-selective photonic lantern multiplexer compatible with 3D nanoprinting technology
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We design mode-selective photonic lantern multiplexer using 3D waveguides made of photopolymer core and air cladding. Although the waveguides exhibit high index contrast, low loss (0.14dB), MDL (-0.06db), and mode group crosstalk (-21.2dB) are obtained. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of an extreme learning machine based on Fabry Perot lasers for parallel neuromorphic processing
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present experimental results regarding dispersion equalization in IM-DD transmission systems with an extreme learning machine based on a Fabry Perot laser. The exploitation of two longitudinal modes yields enhanced computational power and processing speed. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: FrFT Based Joint Time/Frequency Synchronization for Digital Subcarrier Multiplexing System
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose an in-advance time/frequency synchronization method for SCM using fractional Fourier transform pilot. With low complexity and fast speed, the proposed method is validated to be robust against strong filtering and fiber nonlinearity. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: No-polish Air-gap Single-mode Low-loss Multi-fiber Anti-reflection Coated Connector
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We developed a multi-fiber air-gap optical connector which does not require polishing or physical contact between fibers. The developed single-mode connector has an average IL of 0.36dB and RL of 59.3dB with anti-reflective coating.

articleTitle: Building a Global Content Provider Network at Scale
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This tutorial covers scaling the backbone network of a global content provider. Key constraints on network growth are classified and scaling strategies discussed. Optimizations and architecture changes for higher scale are presented.

articleTitle: Modern Subsea Cable Systems: Towards Ultimate Cable Capacity
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This tutorial will discuss the key components in building a subsea cable system from concept to service, and will review the recent technical innovations in advancing the performance and new applications of subsea cable system.

articleTitle: A Control Hierarchy for Integrated Packet-Optical Networks Utilizing Pluggable Transceivers
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A proposed architecture for control of packet-optical networks is analyzed and demonstrated. The specific challenge of managing routers with integrated pluggable WDM transceivers with open optical line systems is addressed while considering standards alignment. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: BTO-enhanced silicon photonics – a scalable PIC platform with ultra-efficient electro-optical modulation
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate an advanced BTO-enhanced silicon photonic platform for high-volume applications in communication, optical computing, and sensing. Our platform exploits an ultra-strong Pockels effect, enabling large-scale, high-speed electro-optic photonic circuits with low power consumption and loss. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: InP-Si3N4 Hybrid Integrated Optical Source for High-purity Mm-wave Communications
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present the optical injection locking to a comb of a hybrid InP-Si3N4 dual laser source for high-purity mm-wave generation. Key performance parameters such as adjacent-comb-line side mode suppression ratio and locking range are reported. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Complementary Polarization-diversity Self-Coherent Homodyne Receiver with Rapid Polarization Tracking for Remote LO
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a complementary polarization-diversity coherent receiver (C-PDCR) based on complementary polarization detection. The proposed C-PDCR features rapid polarization tracking for remote LO using electronic DSP. The robustness is verified by a 1.08-Tb/s dual-polarization PCS-256QAM signal with up to 314-Krad/s polarization tracking speed. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Scalable and Fast Optical Circuit Switch Exploiting Colorless Coherent Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present a scalable and fast wavelength-routing switch employing colorless coherent detection. Some thousand port-count and a few microsecond switching time are realized by using a Silicon-Photonic tunable-filter-based local oscillator bank that enables colorless detection. © 2022 The Authors

articleTitle: First Demonstration of PS-QAM based Flexible Coherent PON in Burst-Mode with 300G Peak-Rate and Record Dynamic-Range and Net-Rate Product up to 7,104 dB·Gbps
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate rate-flexible coherent TDM-PON in burst-mode with dynamic range of >35-dB and power-budget of 39-dB based on probabilistic-shaping QAM modulation, achieving 300G peak-rate and a record dynamic-range and net-rate product up to 7,104 dB·Gbps. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Demonstration of an Air-Water Communication Link Through Dynamic Aerosol and Water Curvature when Considering the 2-D Modal Coupling of a Spatially Structured Beam
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally investigate the 2-D modal power coupling of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$LG_{11}$</tex> and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$HG_{11}$</tex> beams under dynamic aerosol and water curvature, and demonstrate a 1-Gbit/s <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$LG_{11}$</tex> FSO link, having a penalty of ∼3-dB compared with no-effect cases.

articleTitle: >100 Gbps 3×3 MIMO V-Band RoF System for up to 100 m Wireless Transmission Enabled by NN-based Equalization
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This study employs a single neural-network-based nonlinear equalizer in a 3×3 MIMO V-band RoF system for the first time. Experiment results demonstrate >30% improvement in data rate and > 100-Gbps wireless transmission over 100 m. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Effective Area Tilt Impact In S+C+L Band Long-Haul Fiber Optic Transmission Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: In this paper we investigate the impact of effective area tilt on the performance of wideband fiber optic transmission systems, and quantify transmission performance variability associated with the use of different types of terrestrial fibers. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: A 10-Gb/s, −32.6dBm Receiver with 3.5Gbps APD for XGPON/XGSPON Mass Production
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A 10-Gb/s low-power low-noise optical receiver in 65nm CMOS is presented and can achieve a sensitivity of −32.6dBm after pairing with a 3.5Gbps low-cost APD, which provides a solution necessary for mass production of XGPON/XGSPON. © 2021 The Author(s)

articleTitle: 200µm Diameter Fiber for SDM Submarine Networks: Cabling Performance and Record Transmission Result
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: 200µm-diameter fiber is analyzed for SDM systems where capacity is approaching fiber density limitations in standard cable designs. This fiber is fully characterized over a 15000km+ transmission line. This represents, to our knowledge, the first ever ultra-long-haul transmission with 200µm large effective-area fiber.

articleTitle: Applications of P4-based Network Programmability in Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This paper presents potentials and challenges of disaggregated metro-edge networking based on open packet-optical nodes encompassing coherent pluggable modules, SONiC open operating system, and P4-based packet switching programmability. © 2021 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Demonstration of 120-GBaud 16-QAM Driver-less Coherent Transmitter with 80-km SSMF Transmission
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrated a driver-less coherent optical transmitter enabled by a low-V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">π</inf> high-bandwidth thin-film LiNbO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> I/Q modulator. We successfully transmitted a 120-Baud 16-QAM signal with net data rate of 836.2 Gb/s over 80-km SSMF.

articleTitle: Transport Network Upgrade exploiting Multi-Band Systems: S- versus E-band
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Exploiting bands beyond C+L can effectively upgrade network capacity, but Stimulated Raman Scattering (SRS) affects wideband-transmission, potentially degrading active channels. Upgrades exploiting E- and S-band are compared in terms of capacity and number of reconfigurations. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Demonstration of Real-time 125.516 Gbit/s Transparent Fiber-THz-Fiber Link Transmission at 360 GHz ∼ 430 GHz based on Photonic Down-Conversion
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The first real-time transparent fiber-THz-fiber <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$2\times 2$</tex> MIMO transmission system with a record line rate of 125.516 Gbit/s and net data rate of 103.125 Gbit/s is demonstrated at 360 GHz-430GHz based on photonic down-conversion.

articleTitle: High performance thin-film lithium niobate MZ modulator ready for massive production
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Through photolithography we fabricated high-performance thin-film lithium niobate modulators on full 4-inch wafers with low VπL, wide bandwidth and low insertion loss. The waveguide loss is one of the lowest among similar work. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Ultralow-loss Silicon Nitride Waveguides for Parametric Amplification
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report net gain in a continuous-wave-pumped parametric amplifier implemented in a meter-long dispersion-engineered silicon nitride waveguide. These results are enabled by the record-low loss (1.4dB/m) of the waveguide. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Influence of SOA parameters on the nonlinear impairments experienced by QAM modulated signals
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose an experimental method to tune SOA model parameters that yields good prediction abilities of nonlinear distortions induced on PCS-QAM signals. We show that reducing SOA nonlinearities is achieved by a trade-off between a high <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$P_{\text{sat}}$</tex> and a low <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\alpha_{H}$</tex>. © 2021 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Frequency-Time-Division-Multiplexed Single-Pixel Imaging for Biomedical Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate high-speed single-pixel imaging by integrating frequency-division multiplexing and time-division multiplexing and applying the combined technique, namely frequency-time-division multiplexing (FTDM), to optical imaging. We employ the technique to obtain fluorescence images from biological cells. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Any-Double-Link Failure Tolerant Bypass/Backup Switchable WDM-PON Employing Path-Pair Shared Protection and Bidirectional Wavelength Pre-assignment
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose two-of-four long-link failure tolerant path-pair shared protection and bi-directional wavelength pre-assignment for robust bypass/backup-path switchable wavelength-division multiplexing based coherent optical access network systems that experimentally achieve < 2-dB penalty for any double-link failure. © 2022 Authors

articleTitle: Optical Phased Array for 905-nm LIDAR applications integrated on 300mm Si-Photonic Platform
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: In this paper we present the first integration of a 2D Optical Phased Array (OPA) for 905nm LIDAR applications on our 300mm SWIR photonic platform DAPHNE, based on Si & SiN components.

articleTitle: 16 Wavelengths Comb Source Using Large-Scale Hybrid Photonic Integration
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a 16 wavelengths comb source using hybrid integration of 16 gain chips, 32 balls lenses and an arrayed waveguide grating, with total output power >20 mW, SMSR 56 dB, and kHz-scale linewidths. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Dual Laser Indium Phosphide Photonic Integrated Circuits for Remote Active Carbon Dioxide Sensing
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Two generations of indium phosphide photonic integrated circuits were fabricated, characterized, and their performance compared. Successful sampling of carbon dioxide was performed in a laboratory setting under continuous wave sampling. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: A New Era of Video Transmission Using Open Transport System: Challenges in 2020 Sporting Events
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We developed new ultra-low-latency uncompressed video transmission technology using open transport system. The Real-time Remote-cheering Project was successfully implemented using this system by connecting the marathon course in Sapporo with the cheering venue in Tokyo.

articleTitle: Solving Vertex Cover Problem using Quadrature Photonic Spatial Ising Machine
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: In this paper, we solve the 1600-vertex cover problem by a novel quadrature photonic spatial Ising machine. Our work suggests flexible combinational optimization problem solving for Ising models with external magnetic field. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Biomimicry in Microwave Photonic and Fiber Optic Sensors Embedded Soft Robotics
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Biomimicry offers natural and effective solutions to solve critical challenges in wide range of emerging technologies. This paper introduces several bio-inspired dynamic microwave photonic technologies as well as biomimicry in fiber-optic sensors enhanced soft robotics. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: The next decade of optical fibers: implications on system design
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We will review drivers behind innovation in long-haul and subsea optical fiber technology and potential paths in which these fibers could evolve. We will also discuss the ecosystem changes required for each future fiber pathway.

articleTitle: 40GBaud PAM4 silicon Mach-Zehnder modulator boosted by a heterogeneously integrated SOA with 10dB-gain
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report a silicon IQ modulator integrated with a III-V/Si semiconductor optical amplifier (SOA) at the output. We demonstrate 40GBaud PAM4 operation of one of the Mach Zehnder modulators with an SOA gain of 10dB.

articleTitle: A 106 Gb/s 2.5 Vppd Linear Microring Modulator Driver with Integrated Photocurrent Sensor in 28nm CMOS
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A low-power CMOS linear driver IC, optimized for microring modulator-based copackaged optics, is presented. This 2.5 V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">ppd</inf> driver, assembled with a photonic IC, achieves 2 dB TDECQ at 106 Gb/s PAM4 with 1.33 pJ/bit efficiency.

articleTitle: Real-Time 58,2Gb/s Equalization-Free NRZ Mode Burst Transmission for Upstream HS-PON and beyond with Monolithically Integrated SOA-UTC Receiver
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate the capacity of a monolithically integrated SOA-UTC photodiode to meet the HS-PON upstream burst mode sensitivity requirements at 50Gb/s (−26.5dBm and 20km achieved), and record error free performances at 58,2Gb/s. © 2021 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Highly power-efficient (2 pJ/bit), 128Gbps 16QAM signal generation of coherent optical DAC transmitter using 28-nm CMOS driver and all-silicon segmented modulator
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrated a highly power-efficient coherent optical digital-to-analog converter transmitter. 2pJ/bit operation was realized by combining an all-silicon segmented modulator and a CMOS inverter driver. The bit-error-rate was less than the 25.5% of SD-FEC limit. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Optical Damage Threshold Screening Methodology for 28 GBd, Long Wavelength Avalanche Photodiodes
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present a novel scalable wafer screening method that guarantees an optical damage threshold larger than +5 dBm for 28 GBd long wavelength avalanche photodiodes over large-scale production volumes. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Optimal Pay-As-You-Grow Deployment on S+C+L Multi-band Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We investigate the best band upgrade order on an S+C+L system in a pay-as-you-grow approach, aiming to maximize the end-of-life system capacity under the constraint of not disrupting already running services. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Nanosecond-scale Hitless $\lambda$-switching of SOA-integrated Electro-optically Tunable RTF Laser with +/−2.5-GHz Dynamic Frequency Accuracy
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We developed an SOA-integrated electro-optically tunable RTF laser with suppressed spurious wavelengths during dynamic tuning. The laser exhibited hitless (no interference with other channels) nanosecond-scale <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\lambda$</tex>-switching for 128-Gbps coherent signals.

articleTitle: Harnessing Multi-Octave Coherent Light Using Anti-Resonant Fibers
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Gas-filled anti-resonant fibers enable an ultrafast source of phase-stable waveforms with tunable ultra-broadband spectrum spanning from the ultraviolet to the terahertz. The system features higher brightness than synchrotrons, opening horizons in spectroscopy and strong-field physics. © 2022 The Author.

articleTitle: Energy Efficiency in Multi-Access Technologies with a Disaggregated Architecture
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We describe key technologies for a greener ICT for the fixed & mobile access, in-building optical backbones including a novel cooling technology, for DC to ensure energy savings and flexibility for different ICT market segments.

articleTitle: Neural Network-based Fiber Nonlinearity Mitigation in High-speed Coherent Optical Transmission Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: In this paper, we review the recent progress of neural network-based Kerr nonlinearity mitigation techniques in high-speed coherent optical fiber transmission systems. Current studies in both single-carrier and nonlinear frequency division multiplexing systems are discussed. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Groundwater Level Remote Monitoring Using Optical Power Measurement in Fiber Bragg Grating
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Groundwater level provides critical insight to public resource allocation and climate variability. Remote monitoring of groundwater level is demonstrated, based on wavelength-shift induced optical power change in fiber Bragg grating caused by water pressure fluctuations. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: What's the Fuss: The Excitement, Prospects and Software/Hardware Challenges of Distributing Entanglement over a Quantum Network
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: In this paper, I review the notion of a quantum network, which I define as one that can distribute entanglement between stationary qubits, and then discuss challenges relevant for the Optical Fiber Conference (OFC).

articleTitle: 1.5-µm Indium Phosphide-based Quantum Dot Lasers and Optical Amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: An overview will be given on the progress of quantum dot laser materials addressing the telecom C band and their high potential for the application in optical communication systems, where temperature stability of the device performance as well as a narrow linewidth emission plays an important role. Device results of quantum dot lasers and optical amplifiers will be shown, and the physical background discussed.

articleTitle: Side-view Rotational Alignment Method for Trench-assisted 4-core Fibers
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A trench-assisted 4-core fiber has been successfully aligned in fusion splicing by determining an optimal focus position of a fusion splicer and matching the two fibers at the marker using a side-view rotational alignment method. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Flexible Upstream FEC for Higher Throughput, Efficiency, and Robustness for 50G PON
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A low-complexity flexible forward error correction scheme based on different shortening and puncturing of the standard G.hsp 50G PON LDPC mother code to achieve enhanced throughput and robustness in upstream PON is motivated and presented. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Driving Down Link Energy and Driving Up Link Density in GPU Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: GPU-accelerated computing systems, which power the AI revolution, rely on increasing amounts of off-chip I/O. To continue scaling, very dense integration of ultra-efficient optical transceivers alongside next-generation processor die will be needed. © 2022 The Author(s).

articleTitle: Seven-Aperture Direct-Detection Receiver for Free-Space Optical Communication Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a free-space optical communication system utilizing seven-aperture direct-detection receiver. We estimate the instantaneous SNR from the AC-coupled photo-currents and implement the maximal ratio combining by optimizing the averaging time of the photo-current. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Demonstration of a Resilient and Quantum-Secured Time-Shared Optical Network with Multi-Level Programmability
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We have successfully implemented a multilevel programmable network resilience and security for Time-Shared Optical Networks (TSON). A SDN controller enables flexible control of FPGA-based network coding and encryption/decryption cores for secured and resilient TSON. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Entanglement Distribution in Installed Fiber with Coexisting Classical Light for Quantum Network Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We show polarization entangled photons coexisting with milliwatt power classical light over 45.6 km of installed optical fiber. The entanglement source has a built-in alignment signal for quantum transmitter-receiver polarization basis alignment. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Generation of Coherent Multi-Wavelength Lights with Hundreds GHz Frequency Spacing from an Injected Fiber Laser with an Intracavity Tunable Micro-Ring Resonator
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Coherent multi-wavelength lights with 133 and 266 GHz frequency spacing are successfully generated from a new fiber laser scheme. The phase-locking characteristics are examined through the auto-correlation contrast as well as the down-converted beating linewidth. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Demonstration of WDM-Enabled Ultralow-Energy Photonic Edge Computing
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present experimental demonstrations of ultra-low power edge computing enabled by wavelength division multiplexed optical links and time-integrating optical receivers. Initial experimentation demonstrations show ≤ 10 fJ of optical energy per MAC. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Analysis of Potential Four-wave Mixing Risk in 5G Front-haul System
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: FWM is proposed as a new major impairment for 5G front-haul network for the first time. Corresponding theoretical analysis and experiment in FWM penalty have been done for two main commercial plans for comparison. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: 5G Millimeter-Wave Analog RoF System employing Optical Injection Locking and Direct Modulation of DFB Laser
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate the successful generation of 28.2 and 35.3 GHz mm-wave signals through optical injection locking and direct modulation of a DFB laser. The low phase noise mm-wave signal generated supports 5G compatible OFDM signals.

articleTitle: Fiber-on-Chip: Digital FPGA Emulation of Channel Impairments for Real-Time Evaluation of DSP
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We describe the Fiber-on-Chip (FoC) approach, in which digital models are used for real-time emulation of an optical communication system, to achieve cost-effective and reproducible long-term DSP evaluations inside a single chip. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Double-effect DNN-based DBP Scheme for Integrated Sensing and Communications (ISAC)
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A double-effect deep neural network (DNN)-based DBP scheme is developed to integrate communication and sensing, which can mitigate nonlinear interference effectively and estimate optical power distribution accurately through the optimized nonlinear parameters. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Experimental Study of Bandwidth Loading with Modulated Signals vs. ASE Noise in 400ZR Single-Span Transmission
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We compare performance of a single-span 400ZR system with bandwidth loading over 2.4 THz from independent modulated signals, channelized ASE noise, or flat ASE noise bands, and quantify the impact on optimum launch power. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Exploiting Ultra-Low Loss Silicon Nitride Platform for Various Applications (Invited)
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> has attracted extensive interest because of its wide applications in the field of biophotonics, telecommunications, nonlinear optics, and sensing. Here, we focus on exploiting ultra-low loss Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> for on-chip delay line and frequency comb generation. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Message Passing: Towards Low-Complexity, Global Optimal Routing and Wavelength Assignment Solutions for Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We introduce a polynomial-time distributed message passing algorithm for routing and wavelength assignment. Exact global solutions are obtained for small-scale networks and improvements are demonstrated on network scales beyond the reach of established global algorithms. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: III-V Micro/Nano-lasers and photodetectors in the Telecom Band Grown on SOI
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present our recent progress on the III-V micro/nano-lasers and photodetectors (PD) grown on (001) silicon-on-insulators (S OI) for integra ted silicon photonics (Si-photonics) using vertical and lateral selective epitaxy. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Full Spectrum $b$-Modulation of Time-Limited Signals Using Linear Programming
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present the first method for the joint modulation of the continuous and the discrete nonlinear Fourier spectrum of finite duration signals. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Kerr-induced Rotation of Mixed Orbital Angular Momentum States in Hollow Ring-Core Fibers
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate that in the presence of Kerr nonlinearity, the spatial pattern caused by unequal excitation of two degenerate spin-orbit anti-aligned modes in an optical fiber exhibits a power-dependent rotation effect. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Experimental Evaluation of PAM and Polybinary Modulation for Intra-DCI Optical Lanes with up to 300 Gbit/s Net Bitrates
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally test PAM and polybinary modulation in a wide range of symbol rates, as potential candidates to realize next-generation optical lanes. 306-Gbit/s bitrate is demonstrated with 140-GBd PAM-6 signal at sensitivity −17.9-dBm with EDFA-preamplifier. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Highlights of 10-years of Research in a Japanese Si Photonics Project
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Aiming at the convergence of photonics and electronics technologies, a large-scale national project on silicon photonics was launched in Japan in 2012. In this presentation, the activities in this national project are presented, focusing on the development of silicon photonics circuits and the realization of an optical I/O core, a 5 mm square silicon-based chip with integrated quantum dot lasers. The implementation of this project has paved the way towards ultra-small transceiver chips for on-board optics (OBO) and co-packaged optics (CPO) technologies.

articleTitle: Reconfigurable PIC Transmitter for Short Reach Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A novel reconfigurable photonic integrated transmitter, enabling dynamic resource allocation and sharing, is proposed. Architecture, functionality and a deployment scenario are discussed. Preliminary work on machine learning methods for controlling the device are also presented. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Comparison of transfer matrix stability between a 110 km 7-core coupled-core multi-core fiber and single-mode fiber
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We use dual-comb spectroscopy to compare the stability and wavelength dependence of mode coupling in a 110 km coupled multi-core and a regular single-mode fiber. Phase and intensity fluctuations are compared, revealing differences in coupling dynamics. © 2022 The Authors.

articleTitle: Long Short-Term Memory Neural Network to Enhance the Data Rate and Performance for Rolling Shutter Camera Based Visible Light Communication (VLC)
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose and demonstrate using Long-Short-Term-Memory neural-network (LSTM-NN) to mitigate inter-symbol-interference (ISI) in 4-level pulse-amplitude-modulation (PAM4) camera based visible-light-communication (VLC) system. Data-rate of 14.4-kbit/s with 3-m free-space transmission is achieved. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Quantum Key Distribution in the Service Provider Network
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We review and discuss the practicalities of integrating Quantum Key Distribution within the service provider fiber network. © 2022 The Authors.

articleTitle: Core Selective Switch Supporting 15 Cores Per Port Using Bundled Three 5-Core Fibers
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We prototyped a 15-core 1×8 core selective switch (CSS). The high core count CSS is achieved by bundling three 5-core fibers (5-CFs) and collimating/demultiplexing beams from the input bundled three 5-CFs using a single microlens. © 2022 The Authors

articleTitle: Net 1 Tbps/λ Transmission Over 80 km of SSMF Using a Single Segment SiP IQM With All-Electronic Equalization
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We achieve net 1 Tbps (line-rate 1.26 Tbps) transmission using a single-segment travelling-wave SiP IQ modulator at 105 Gbaud DP-64QAM below the 25% SD-FEC-threshold over 80 km of SSMF with all-electronic equalization and non-linear pre-distortion.

articleTitle: III-V-on-Silicon-Nitride Mode-Locked Lasers
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate heterogeneously integrated passively mode-locked lasers by microtransfer printing III-V semiconductor optical amplifiers on a silicon nitride photonic chip. Hereby, dense and low-noise optical laser comb sources can be made. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Dispersion Compensation of 30GBaud/s NRZ and PAM4 data using integrated Silicon Nitride Gratings
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Dispersion compensation is demonstrated using on-chip Silicon Nitride Bragg Gratings. Impaired 30GBaud/s NRZ and PAM4 eye diagrams are restored and a power penalty improvement of 1.3dB at a Bit Error Rate of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−12</sup> is achieved.

articleTitle: Energy efficient OEO conversion and its applications to photonic integrated systems
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We describe nanophotonics-based opto-electric devices and their femtofarad integration. The combination of these devices and optical interference units has a potential to provide energy-efficient and ultra-low latency optical information processing. © 2021 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Highly Reliable Organic Polymer Optical Modulators
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{a} > 100$</tex> Gbaud transmission using a thermo-physically enhanced EO polymer modulator. The error-free signal over a distance of 2.0 km was successfully demonstrated under high-temperature exposure at up to 110°C.

articleTitle: Symbiotic joint operation of quantum and classical coherent communications
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report successful joint operation of quantum and classical communications with shared hardware. Leveraging information learned from the classical DSP, low-noise quantum communications (0.009 SNU at 15 km) compatible with 15 Mbit/s QKD is demonstrated. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Single-mode emission from a topological lattice with distributed gain and dielectric medium
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a monolithically integrated active topological photonic structure. Using a unique design with distributed gain/dielectric medium, we selectively address the topological mode to achieve robust and tunable continuous-wave single-mode emission at room temperature.

articleTitle: 372 Tb/s Unrepeatered 213 km Transmission Over a 125 µm Cladding Diameter, 4-Core MCF
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a 372.8 Tb/s unrepeatered 213.3 km link using a 4-core multi-core fiber with standard cladding diameter and bidirectional Raman amplification. We transmit 424×24.5 GBaud PM-64QAM signals in the C+L bands for a capacity-distance product of 79.5 Pb/s.km. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: A Bi-Directional Fiber-FSO-5G MMW/ 5G NR Sub-THz Converged System
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A bi-directional fiber-FSO-5G wireless converged system with downlink 40-Gb/s/100-GHz 5G NR sub-THz, and uplink 10-Gb/s/28-GHz and 10-Gb/s/24-GHz 5G MMW signals is constructed. It develops a brilliant convergence for high-speed and long-reach transmission with qualified performance.

articleTitle: Weak Carrier Assisted Phase Retrieval Receiver
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a weak carrier-assisted phase-retrieval receiver to obtain initial phase for modified Gerchberg-Saxton algorithm with fast convergence to realize hardware-efficient, computationally-efficient, and pilot-symbol-free optical field recovery, and compare it with other phase retrieval schemes.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Deep Reinforcement Learning for Restoration in Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A deep reinforcement learning-based agent is presented to perform autonomous lightpath restoration upon a link failure event. The agent is evaluated against other heuristic algorithms under different traffic load and failure duration scenarios. © 2022 The Au-thor(s)

articleTitle: High power BDF/EDF hybrid amplifier providing 27 dB gain over 90 nm in the $\mathrm{E}+\mathrm{S}$ band
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A hybrid amplifier based on bismuth-doped fiber and erbium-doped fiber, producing > 27 dB gain and 24.5 dBm of output power from 1431 nm to 1521 nm, is reported. This demonstration showcases the potential of bismuth-doped fibers in opening new wavelength transmission windows. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: A continuous variable quantum microcomb with 2.1 dB raw squeezing
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a squeezed quantum microcomb consisting of 22 simultaneously two-mode squeezed comb pairs (44 qumodes) with maximum raw squeezing of 2.1 dB, which can serve as the building bricks for scalable continuous-variable-based quantum computing. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Telecom-band Hyperentangled Photon Pairs from a Fiber-based Source
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the generation of telecom-band biphotons hyperentangled in both the polarization and frequency DoFs using a periodically-poled silica fiber and observe entanglement concurrences above 0.95 for both DOFs. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: High-speed White Light Visible Light Communication (VLC) Based on Semipolar (20-21) Blue micro-Light Emitting Diode (µ-LED)
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a record 2.473-Gbit/s white-light visible-light-communication (VLC) using semipolar (20–21) blue InGaN/GaN µ-LED with yellow-phosphor. The measured 3-dB-bandwidth of blue and white lights are 1042.5 MHz and 772.4 MHz respectively. © 2022 Author(s)

articleTitle: Spectrum and Cost Savings from Beyond-100Gbaud Optical Transponders
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We quantify spectrum usage and transponder cost when deploying next-generation transponders that support up to 1.6 Tbit/s, in both C- and C+L bands. We compare two transponder architectures: a) single-carrier, operating beyond 100 Gbaud and b) multi-carrier with each carrier operating below 100 Gbaud. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Beyond Mrad/s Polarization Tracking Speed of Complementary Polarization-diversity Coherent Receiver for Remote LO
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a complementary polarization-diversity coherent receiver (C-PDCR) to accommodate arbitrarily varying SOP of remotely delivered LO. The polarization tracking speed can reach 1 Mrad/s without performance degradation and exceed 2 Mrad/s with a 1-dB OSNR penalty for a 1.08-Tb/s dual-polarization (DP) PCS-256QAM signal. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: A Novel Structure Design Method of Delta-Sigma Modulator based on Genetic Algorithm for Mobile Fronthaul
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We proposed a novel structure design method of delta-sigma modulator based on genetic algorithm. Compared to the traditional method, SNR of the restored signal under the optimized structure at the receiver is increased by ~6dB. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: QoT-Driven Optical Control and Data Plane in Multi-Vendor Disaggregated Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A novel disaggregated network architecture with independent PCE and optical control based on GNPy is proposed and experimentally validated over a network including two independent OLSs for total 1400 km, ROADM whiteboxes and pluggable transceivers. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: First Demonstration of a Single-$\lambda$, Full-Duplex RRH Transceiver with Single RF Carrier for Bidirectional Radio
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We successfully the reception and transmission of radio signals over the same opto-electronic port and at the same RF carrier frequency at the same time. We find >2% EVM margins for 16/64-QAM OFDM down-/uplink transmission. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Impact of Local Oscillator Phase Noise on Long-Haul Transmission of 120-Gbaud Digital Sub-Carrier Signals
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The EEPN penalty was measured separately from other factors in 5120-km transmission of 120-Gbaud 16QAM signal for different LO lasers. Digital subcarrier multiplexing suppressed the EEPN-induced NGMI deterioration by ~0.4 at 102,400 ps/nm. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Interactive Visual Analytics Dashboard for the Paradigm of ML-assisted Autonomous Optical Networking
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a novel visualization dashboard, compatible with multiple data and telemetry sources, which offers dataset quality evaluation, dataset comparison, ML model error analysis interpretation, and network health monitoring. © 2020 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Traffic Tolerance of Nanosecond Scheduling on Optical Circuit Switched Data Center Network
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: PULSE's ns-speed NP-hard network scheduler delivers skew-tolerant performance at 90% input loads. It achieves >90% throughput, 1.5-1.9 µs mean and 16–24 µs tail latency (99%) for up to 6:1 hot:cold skewed traffic in OCS DCN. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Wide Field-of-View (FOV) Light-Diffusing Fiber Optical Transmitter for Rolling Shutter based Optical Camera Communication (OCC)
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a wide field-of-view (FOV) light-diffusing-fiber (LDF) transmitter optical-camera-communication (OCC). Pixel-row-per-bit-neural-network (PRPB-NN) is employed for rolling-shutter-pattern decoding. PRPB-NN provides efficient decoding at 360° around LDF circumference and 160° Rx rotation-angle at 2100-bit/s. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Emerging Optical Interconnects for AI Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The ever-growing demand for accurate machine learning models resulted in an increase in dataset and model sizes of deep neural networks. This paper discusses reconfig-urable optical networks as the key enabler for scaling AI systems. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Ultra Compact Athermal 400G-FR4 Silicon Photonics Receiver with Polarization Diversity
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We have successfully demonstrated an ultra-compact WDM 400G-FR4 ROSA module integrated with silicon photonics circuits operating at 53.125Gbaud PAM4 signal with a sensitivity of −6.0dBm optical modulation amplitude at KP4 Pre-FEC-BER=2.4e-4.

articleTitle: Automatic Waveguide Balancing Using Point Set Operations
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: An algorithm based on point set operations is developed to solve the waveguide length-balancing problem in silicon photonics layout. The method is applicable to complex photonic circuits incorporating multiple waveguide levels (e.g. Si and SiN).

articleTitle: Temperature Dependent Characteristics of L-band EDFA Using Phosphorus- and High Aluminum-Co-doped Silica Fibers
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report a hybrid L-band amplifier employing phosphosilicate and high-aluminosilicate EDFs with 20.2±3.7dB gain and 4.2dB average NF from 1575-1615nm. The temperature-dependent-gain coefficient remains almost constant from 1585-1615nm over the temperature range −60 to +80°C. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Experimental validation of nonlinear Fourier transform-based Kerr-nonlinearity identification over a 1600km SSMF link
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Recently, a nonlinear Fourier transform-based Kerr-nonlinearity identification algorithm was demonstrated for a 1000km NZDSF link with accuracy of 75%. Here, we demonstrate an accuracy of 99% over 1600 km SSMF. Reasons for improved accuracy are discussed. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: 84-fiber MPO connector employing solid refractive index matching material formed on perpendicular polished MT ferrule end
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate 84-fiber MPO connector employing a perpendicular MT ferrule and solid refractive index matching material that can overcome the extreme difficulty posed by the design and manufacturing of multi-fiber connectors holding many fibers. © 2021 The Author(s)

articleTitle: 384-Gb/s/lane PAM8 Operation Using 76-GHz Bandwidth EA-DFB Laser at 50°C with 1.0-Vpp Swing over 2-km Transmission
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: 384-Gb/s PAM8 operation of both BTB and 2-km were demonstrated by a lumped-electrode type EA-DFB laser with clear eye-openings. 4.6 dB extinction ratio with 1.0- Vpp and 9.8 dBm output power were obtained at 50°C. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: 10 Gbps Laser Communication for Low Earth Orbit Satellites with Volterra and Machine Learning Nonlinear Compensation Providing Link Budget up to 74 dB
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We invesigate the power-link budget of 10Gbps laser communication. The comparison of the DML nonlinearity effects between OFDM and SC-FDE is discussed. With Volterra and machine-learning nonlinear compensation, the power-link budget achieve up to 74 dB.

articleTitle: How to Connect Device Nonlinear Specification and System Nonlinear Penalty
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: From system design point of view, it's required to estimate nonlinear system performance from device nonlinear specification. We discuss various technologies about this topic and find the problem is only partially solved. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Ultra-Low Latency Short Packet Transmission Experiments with Optical Bus Platform Based on PCIe
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose an optical bus platform architecture that provides an ultra-low latency path for small traffic on metro-scale networks. We experimentally demonstrate that remote memory can be accessed over 25 km in 244.2 μs. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Design and Dynamic Control of Fiber-Granular Routing Networks with Next-Generation Optical Paths
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Efficient network design and control algorithms for fiber-granular routing networks are proposed. Routing performance of next-generation broad-bandwidth optical paths on fiber-granular routing networks with over <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$100\times 100$</tex> fiber-cross-connects is verified. © 2022 The Authors

articleTitle: An Optimized Full-spectrum Modulated NFDM System by Combining Geometric Shaping and Linear Minimum Mean Square Error Estimator
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We elaborately design a full-spectrum modulated NFDM system with b-scheme. A 1120km transmission with BER < 3.8 ×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−3</sup> at 103.75 Gbps is achieved through geometric shaping (GS) and linear minimum mean square error (LMMSE) estimator. © 2021 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Large-scale Programmable Integrated Photonic Circuits: From Microwave Photonics to Optical Computing
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Multipurpose programmable circuits promise to achieve arbitrary functionality and dynamic system operation as an alternative to custom fixed design. This work reviews the fundaments, programming methods, and performance of its application to microwave-photonics and computing.

articleTitle: Degradation mechanisms and lifetime assessment of Ge Vertical PIN photodetectors
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Dark current degradation mechanisms in Ge VPIN photodetectors were studied. A methodology to estimate the failure percentages has been developed and applied. Degradation/recovery processes and E<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">a</inf>-decrease of I<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">dark</inf> after stress suggest increased TAT during degradation.

articleTitle: Temperature Tolerant On-Chip WDM Silicon Photonic Transmitter and AWGR-based Routing Interconnects
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate automated thermal drift compensation in a two-socket AWGR interconnect, incorporating a ring-modulator transmitter. Stable operation with an average <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{Q}=5.8$</tex> over a range of 9°C is achieved for 25 Gb/s on-chip modulated data.

articleTitle: Group-velocity Dispersion Compensation of Telecom Data Signals using Compact Discrete Phase Filters in Silicon
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a discrete phase filter design suitable for group-velocity dispersion compensation of data signals in fiber-optics telecommunication links using waveguide Bragg gratings in silicon. Dispersion compensation of a 24-Gbps NRZ-OOK signal after propagation through 31.12 km of SMF is experimentally demonstrated using mm-long phase filters. © 2021 The Author(s)

articleTitle: O-Band Fiber-to-Chip Edge Coupler for High NA Fiber Based on a CMOS Compatible SOI Platform
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A SiN edge coupler is experimentally demonstrated with <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{a} < 1.9$</tex> dB/facet loss over the whole O band for a <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$4\mu\mathrm{m}$</tex> MFD fiber. The power is further transformed into Si waveguide using a SiN-to-Si transition.

articleTitle: Slice-Less Optical Arbitrary Waveform Measurement (OAWM) in a Bandwidth of More Than 600 GHz
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate an optical arbitrary waveform measurement (OAWM) technique that exploits optical frequency combs as multi-wavelength local oscillators (LO) and that does not require any optical slicing filters. In a proof-of-concept experiment, we achieve record-high bandwidths exceeding 600 GHz.

articleTitle: Behavioral PAM-4 VCSEL Model using Stochastic Multimode Rate Equations for Link Design Optimization
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A stochastic multimode laser model aimed at optimizing optical links is proposed. The model simulates experimental results from commercial VCSELs and depicts transverse mode effects that are increasingly important in high-speed PAM-4 links. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: A CMOS Compatible On-Chip MMI based Wavelength Diplexer with 60 Gbit/s System Demonstration
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: An ultra-compact <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(41\mu \mathrm{m})$</tex> 1310/1550 nm diplexer with an insertion loss < 1 dB and extinction ratio > 20 dB for both the wavelengths is demonstrated. Furthermore, experiments show clear eye diagrams at 60 Gbit/s signals. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Growth and Sustainability Aspects of WDM
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Internet growth leads to exponentially increasing WDM-systems energy consumption. WDM systems should be replaced by more-efficient successors after certain time to optimize related use-phase carbon emissions. These emissions are overcompensated by the Greening-by-ICT effect. © 2021 The Author.

articleTitle: Coherent Combining at Ultra-low Optical Signal Powers based on Optically Amplified Error Feedback
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Coherent combining in multi-aperture reception for free-space communication applications requires active phase alignment. Here, using 50/50-fiber-couplers and optically preamplified error feedback, coherent combining of four −80dBm, 10Gbaud QPSK signals is demonstrated with 95.4% efficiency. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Self-configuring programmable photonics for processing, communications and sensing
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Silicon photonics allows remarkably complex interferometric optical circuits. Novel algorithms and architectures, including self-configuring and self-stabilizing approaches, can control these, enabling new functions and applications, and a new class of programmable optical components and systems. © 2021 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Design of Asymptotically Perfect Linear Feedforward Photonic Circuits
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a new architecture for feedforward photonic circuits based on a 3-splitter MZI. This architecture is more error tolerant than the standard mesh, supports self-configuration, and yields asymptotically perfect circuits for large mesh sizes. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: An SDN Control Plane for Multiband Networks Exploiting a PLI-aware Routing Engine
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report the design of a TAPI SDN control plane for multi-band networks with externalized PLI-aware RMSA. We detail the architecture, data model extensions, algorithms and the implementation and validation in an emulated BT 22-ROADM network. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Photonics-Based 300 GHz Band Wireless Terahertz Link using 10Gbps Directly-Modulated Monolithically-Integrated Novel Dual-Mode Laser as Beating Light Source
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a photonics-based 300GHz band wireless terahertz (THz) link using our directly modulated novel dual-mode laser (DML) as the beating light source. We have obtained 10Gbps transmission over a single channel.

articleTitle: Impact of GAWBS in Communication Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Guided acoustic wave Brillouin scattering (GAWBS) in modern communication system is overviewed. We discuss induced penalties, GAWBS scattering coefficient estimation, GAWBS detection, compensation, and modeling of various aspects of GAWBS. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Demonstration of Turbulence Resilient Self-Coherent Free-Space Optical Communications Using a Pilot Tone and an Array of Smaller Photodiodes for Bandwidth Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a 4-Gbit/s 16-QAM turbulence-resilient self-coherent free-space optical link using a pilot tone. An array of smaller photodiodes is used to potentially increase the overall bandwidth under turbulence <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(\mathrm{D}/\mathrm{r}_{0}=\sim 8.4)$</tex>.

articleTitle: Integrated Ultra-Narrow Linewidth Stabilized SBS Lasers
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Frequency-stabilized, spectrally-pure lasers are key to precision scientific applications including quantum, atomic clocks, and metrology. We discuss progress towards integrating aspects of these systems to the chip-scale using <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{Si}_{3}\mathrm{N}_{4}$</tex> Brillouin lasers and ultra-high Q resonators. © 2022 The Author(s).

articleTitle: Electrically pumped high power laser transmitter integrated on thin-film lithium niobate
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate an integrated high-power laser on thin-film lithium niobate with 60-mW of optical power in the waveguides. We use this platform to realize a high-power transmitter consisting of an electrically-pumped laser integrated with a 50-GHz modulator.

articleTitle: Comparison of Al2O3 and HfO2 MOSCAP III-V/Si Power Splitters and (De-) Interleavers for DWDM Optical Links
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We compare III-V/Si MZIs and (de-)interleavers using Al<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>- and Hf0<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>-based MOSCAP structures as phase tuners. Hf0<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> twice as thick as Al<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> exhibited lower <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{V}_{\pi}\mathrm{L}$</tex>. We demonstrate crosstalk improvement of ring-assisted (de-)interleavers with both structures.

articleTitle: Transmission of Tb/s CPRI-equivalent Rate Using Coherent Digital-Analog Radio-over-Fiber (DA-RoF) System
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A coherent digital-analog radio-over-fiber (DA-RoF) system is proposed and experimentally demonstrated. An EVM below 3.5% with a CPRI equivalent rate of 1 Tb/s is achieved using a 25 Gbaud dual-polarization signal over a 10-km distance. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Exploration and practice of Computing Power Network(CPN) to realize convergence of computing and network
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: For the optimum leveraging of the distributed computing, network and storage resources in the network with edge computing, we proposed a novel network technology-Computing Power Network (CPN) for the convergence of computing and network resources. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Multi-Cluster Reconfiguration with Traffic Prediction in Hyper-Flex-LION Architecture
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We study the performance of Hyper-Flex-LION optical interconnect architecture under dynamic traffic with traffic-prediction-aided multi-cluster reconfiguration. The simulation results show a 17.2% latency improvement and 36.9% packet loss reduction as compared to a fixed topology. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Power consumption and FWM crosstalk analysis of a hybrid S-band amplifier based on two parametric wavelength converters and an EDFA
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We measure and analyze the power efficiency and four-wave-mixing crosstalk of a hybrid S-band amplifier based on parametric wavelength converters and EDFA at input signal levels from −30 to −20 dBm/ch and 20-dB gain. © 2022 The Authors

articleTitle: Perturbation-aided deep neural network for dual-polarization optical communication systems
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a perturbation-aided deep neural network for fiber nonlinearity compensation in polarization-multiplexed optical communication systems. The proposed technique achieves a fast convergence that is facilitated by the perturbation analysis and attains an enhanced performance.

articleTitle: Stripping-Free Direct Fiber Insertion Connectors Using Thin-Coated Optical Fibers
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
