articleTitle: SDM-TDM Reception Based on MIMO Carrier Phase Recovery Technique for Scalable SDM Transmission
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose MIMO carrier phase recovery (CPR) scheme and its application into SDM-TDM reception. The use of MIMO-CPR with SDM-TDM reception simplifies local oscillator input architecture, hence enabling three-mode-multiplexed 4600-km transmission with single coherent receiver. © 2021 The Author(s)

articleTitle: 50-Tb/s (1 Tb/s × 50 ch) WDM Transmission on Two 6.25-THz Bands Using Hybrid Inline Repeater of PPLN-based OPAs and Incoherent-forward-pumped DRA
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate 50-Tb/s WDM transmission within 6.25-THz band over 240-km SMF using a novel hybrid inline repeater consisting of PPLN-based OPAs and incoherent-forward-pumped DRA. 1-Tb/s/lambda PS-64QAM channels are transmitted within each the S/C-band or C/L-band. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Simultaneously Calibration of Tx/Rx Frequency Response and IQ Skew for Coherent Optical Transceiver
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report a calibration method that can simultaneously characterize frequency-response and IQ-skew of coherent optical transceivers with laser frequency offset and phase noise. 50/40GBaud Nyquist-16/64QAM signals transmission is achieved using 22GHz commercial coherent optical transceiver.

articleTitle: Experimental Demonstration of Adaptive-Optics-Based Turbulence Mitigation in a Mode-Multiplexed Free-Space Optical Link by Using both Radial and Azimuthal Spatial Indices
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate turbulence mitigation by adaptive optics for a 400-Gbit/s free-space link multiplexing four Laguerre Gaussian modes using both radial and azimuthal indices. The turbulence-induced power loss and crosstalk are reduced by ∼10 dB and ∼18 dB, respectively.

articleTitle: Digital-Analog Co-Design for Precision Compressed Integrated Photonic Convolution Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Digital-Analog Co-design for photonic CNN with compressed precision is proposed to answer 3 practical concerns about analog precision: measurement and its mapping to digital domain, minimum demand of physical layer conditions and cheap methods to improve the performance of photonic CNN with poor precision. © 2021 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Hybrid Amplification Approach to Communications beyond C- and L-Bands
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This report introduces novel techniques to amplify new bandwidths rather than C- and L-band by utilizing advantages of each amplification phenomena such as high power efficiency and flexible bandwidth to overcome each of its drawback. © 2022 The Author

articleTitle: New Use Cases for PONs Beyond Residential Services
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: New use cases for PON are highlighted in critical network infrastructures and industrial factories. Introduction of more flexibility and increased determinism including bounded latency, low jitter, highly secure and available connectivity over PON is addressed.

articleTitle: 112-Gb/s PAM-4 IM/DD Optical Transmission over 100-km Single Mode Fiber with Linear Equalizer
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a hybrid linearization algorithm combining the multi-constraint iteration and linear equalization. We experimentally demonstrate a 112-Gb/s PAM-4 signal transmission over 100-km SSMF in IM/DD optical transmission system with one single-ended photodiode.

articleTitle: Silicon Photonics for 800G and Beyond: [invited]
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Future optical transceivers will rely on silicon photonics to address the increasing need for high capacity density and energy efficiency. We review its applications in 800G and beyond and highlight the challenges ahead. © 2022 II-VI Incorporated

articleTitle: Using Received-Signal-Strength (RSS) Pre-Processing and Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) to Enhance Position Accuracy in Visible Light Positioning (VLP)
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a received-signal-strength (RSS) pre-processing scheme to mitigate light-deficient-region occurred in visible-light-positioning (VLP) and convolutional-neural-network (CNN) to enhance VLP performance. The RSS pre-processing and CNN model are discussed. © 2022 Author(s)

articleTitle: DAS over 1,007-km Hybrid Link with 10-Tb/s DP-16QAM Co-propagation using Frequency-Diverse Chirped Pulses
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report the first distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) results over>1,000 km on a field-lab hybrid link using chirped-pulses with correlation detection and 20× frequency-diversity, achieving a sensitivity of 100 pa/√Hz at 20-meters spatial resolution. © 2022

articleTitle: Remote Drone Detection and Localization with Fiber-Optic Microphones and Distributed Acoustic Sensing
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate the first fiber-optic drone detection method with ultra-highly sensitive optical microphones and distributed acoustic sensor. Accurate drone localization has been achieved through acoustic field mapping and data fusion. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Digitally Controlled Silicon Nitride Optical Switch
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report the first <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$1 \times 3$</tex> silicon nitride optical switch using silicon electrostatic MEMS actuator with a 4.97 dB average insertion loss over the 1530 nm to 1580 nm wavelength range. © 2021 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Analysis of Impact of Polarization Dependent Loss in Point to Multi-Point Subsea Communication Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report on numerical investigation of the impact of polarization dependent loss generated by the wavelength selective switches as well as the amplifiers in a point to multi-point subsea-systems. We show that penalties due to R-OADM do not exceed 0.5dB when WSS PDL's is below 0.33dB for 15 in-line WSS.

articleTitle: Comparison between the Optical Performance of Photonic Bandgap and Antiresonant Hollow Core Fibers after Long-Term Exposure to the Atmosphere
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We measure the changes in transmission properties of two different hollow core fiber types exposed to standard atmosphere over nearly one year. No degradation of transmitted power is observed for the hollow-core NANF studied.

articleTitle: LYNX: A GNPy-based web application for multi-vendor optical network planning
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate LYNX, a web-based application for network planning. Built on top of GNPy, it automates the design of user-defined or already built-in network topology, dynamic resource provisioning, network recovery and optimization. © 2021 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Generation and Detection of 200-GBaud Signals via Electrical Multiplexing
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We review the generation and detection of 200-GBaud optical signals and discuss the system design metrics and signal integrity.

articleTitle: Digital Twin-Assisted Optical Power Allocation for Flexible and Customizable SNR Optimization
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A digital twin-enabled power allocation scheme is proposed to realize flexible SNR optimization using Autoencoder. Three customized SNR targets are achieved, which is useful for accurate margin planning in mixed-line-rate transmission systems.

articleTitle: Nano-iTLA based on Multi-Channel Interference Widely Tunable Laser
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A nano-iTLA based on multi-channel interference widely tunable lasers was demonstrated for the first time. The module exhibits a tuning range> 48 nm, SMSR > 45 dB and Lorentzian linewidth < 100 kHz. ©2021 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Variable Focus Lens-Based Beam Steering and Divergence Control for WDM Free-Space Optical Communication
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We investigate through experiments the wavelength dependence of optical beam steering and divergence control technique realized by variable focus lenses (VFLs). We also transmit 4×10-Gb/s signals over a 104-m free-space link using the VFL-based system. © 2021 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Optical Field Characterization using Off-axis Digital Holography
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Angular resolved digital holography is presented as a technique for real-time characterization of the full optical field (amplitude and phase) of space-division multiplexing components and fibers, here a 6-mode photonic-lantern is characterized.

articleTitle: SDM Enabled Record Field Trial Achieving 300+ Tbps Trans-Atlantic Transmission Capacity
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A per fiber-pair real-time capacity of 25.6 Tbps is demonstrated with 0.5 dB Q-factor commissioning margin across 6611 km of SDM enabled trans-Atlantic link aggregating to a record 307.2 Tbps on a single submarine cable. ©2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Capacity Region Bounds for $K$-User Optical WDM Channels with Peak Power Constraints
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We study an optical WDM channel from an interference channel viewpoint. An achievable rate region that strictly outperforms treating interference as noise is presented, along with a capacity region outer bound. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Highly Reliable Outdoor 400G FSO Transmission Enabled by ANN Channel Estimation
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Using an ANN channel estimator, we experimentally demonstrate an outdoor 400G FSO-link with slow-fading prediction and compensation. A transmission reliability of more than 99% is obtained after 3-hour BER measurements. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Free-space Optics for Communications at Sea
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We discuss our free-space-optical communication system, specifically exploring tradeoffs in pointing, acquisition, and tracking design and the use of retransmission to mitigate the impact of turbulence-induced fades. © 2022 The Authors

articleTitle: A Field Trial of 50G TDM-PON Based 5G Small Cell Backhaul
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a field trial of 50G TDM-PON based small cell backhaul. Multiple user equipment are connected to two 5G base stations simultaneously. The maximum download speed of each user equipment reaches nearly 1000 Mbps. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Role of Coherent System in the Next DCI Generation
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Coherent Transmission has been the standard for fiber optic transmission beyond 40 km for over a decade. We review its continuing role for DCI at 400 and 800 Gbps and higher rates.

articleTitle: Long-distance random fiber laser sensing system with ultra-fast signal demodulation
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Based on shape characteristics of the Raman gain spectrum, we extend the Random fiber laser remote sensing scenarios from quasi-static to dynamic, achieving 10 kHz signal demodulation over 100 km fiber. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Evolution of Short-Range Optical Wireless Communications
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Optical wireless communications (OWC) explore the broad unregulated optical spectrum to provide high speed wireless communications, which are promising in beyond 5G. We will discuss the fundamentals and recent developments of short-range OWC systems in this tutorial.

articleTitle: Optical Fiber Micro Spectrometer Employing Self-Focusing Radiated Tilted Fiber Grating
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose and demonstrate an all-fiber micro spectrometer based on self-focusing radiated tilted fiber grating, which has the tunability in both spectral resolution and measurement range by simply changing the radian curvature of the self-focusing radiated tilted fiber grating. © 2022 The Author(s).

articleTitle: Reduced Coating Diameter Fibers for High Density Cables
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We review recent progress on reduced coating diameter fibers for increasing core density for optical interconnect applications. We discuss design considerations on microbending and mechanical reliability and present new experimental results. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Reduced Complexity Adaptive Background Compensation of Electro-Optic Tx Impairments in Coherent Optical Transceivers
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a novel background compensation of electro-optic Tx impairments for coherent optical transmitters based on the backpropagation algorithm and a direct detection low bandwidth feedback channel. Its excellent effectiveness is demonstrated by computer simulations. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Hollow Core Fibers: Key Properties, Technology Status and Telecommunication Opportunities
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Francesco Poletti, Marco Petrovich, Yong Chen, Greg Jasion, Eric Numkam Fokoua, Natalie Wheeler, Tom Bradley, Hesham Sakr, John Hayes, Ian Davidson

articleTitle: Proof-of-Concept Demonstration of Time Critical Periodic Traffic in Industry-grade Passive Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a standards compliant, but enhanced XGS- PON as part of a TSN network that supports industrial (time critical and periodic) traffic with sub-microsecond jitter, maintained even with the addition of best effort traffic.

articleTitle: IOWN for digital twin enabled societies
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Achieving the extreme data volume and velocity requirements of digital twin applications energy-efficiently is challenging. IOWN will address this challenge by making architectural shifts in computing and networking with the evolution of optical technologies.

articleTitle: 1.0-Tb/s/λ 3840-km and 1.2-Tb/s/λ 1280-km Transmissions with 168-GBaud PCS-QAM Signals Based on AMUX Integrated Frontend Module
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We successfully demonstrate 1.0-Tb/s/λ 3840-km and 1.2-Tb/s/λ 1280-km long-haul transmissions in 4.2-THz full C-band 175-GHz-spaced WDM configuration with improving signal noise tolerance using 168-GBaud high-symbol-rate PCS-16QAM and PCS-36QAM signals generated by our AMUX-integrated frontend module. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Dynamic and Efficient Point-to-Point and Point-to-Multipoint Communications by Slicing the Optical Constellation
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Optical Constellation Slicing is proposed to convey heterogenous traffic from a source to multiple destinations, while supporting dynamic capacity allocation. Illustrative numerical results reveal the potential of the proposed scheme, while providing significant cost reduction. © 2022 The Authors

articleTitle: Accelerating Distributed Machine Learning in Disaggregated Architectures with Flexible Optically Interconnected Computing Resources
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We introduce an optically interconnected disaggregated architecture for GPU resources and demonstrate a 3 x increase in GPU utilization and up to 73.2% acceleration of application runtime for distributed machine learning workloads. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Streamlined Architecture for Thermal Control and Stabilization of Cascaded DWDM Micro-Ring Filters Bus
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate the thermal control of cascaded micro-ring DWDM filters using a single photodiode. The streamlined implementation maintains stable operation of the 8-ring bus with less than 0.1dB BER power penalty on an <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$8\times 10\text{Gb}/\mathrm{s}$</tex> link. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Silicon Photonics 630-Gb/s Complementary Polarization-Diversity Coherent Receiver with 9-Mrad/s Polarization Tracking Speed for Self-Coherent Homodyne Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate the first on-chip complementary polarization-diversity coherent receiver (C-PDCR) for rapid polarization tracking of remote LO. Based on electronic MIMO DSP, the polarization tracking speed can reach 9 Mrad/s with negligible performance degradation for a 70-Gbaud dual-polarization (DP) PCS-64QAM signal with 630-Gb/s data rate (net rate 485 Gb/s). © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: 254.6 Mb/s Secret Key Rate Transmission over 13.5 km SMF Using PCS-256QAM Super-Channel Continuous Variable Quantum Key Distribution
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally validate the feasibility of wavelength-division multiplexing for continuous-variable quantum-key-distribution, transmitting four 600 MBaud probabilistically-shaped 256-QAM signals with 4 GHz spacing, achieving total 254.6 Mb/s average secret key rate.

articleTitle: Dynamic Reconfiguration of WDM Virtual Network Topology over SDM Networks for Spatial Channel Failure Recovery with gRPC Telemetry
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the dynamic reconfiguration of WDM VNTs in response to SDM spatial channel failures. We present an SDN control architecture with gRPC-telemetry and analytics to detect failures and restore failed virtual WDM links ©2022 The Authors.

articleTitle: 100 Gbit/s THz Data Transmission and Beyond using Multicore Fiber Combined with UTC Photodiode Array
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Photonics-driven transmitters are leading the race towards high data-rates at THz frequencies. Here, spatial-multiplexing based on multicore fiber and photodiodes array is considered to alleviate the limited output power. Sub-systems have been developed and validated.

articleTitle: Fully Integrated Solid-State LiDAR Transmitter on a Multi-Layer Silicon-Nitride-on-Silicon Photonic Platform
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrated a LiDAR transmitter incorporating both a hybrid-integrated tunable external cavity laser and a high-resolution 2-D optical phased array beam-steerer on a tri-layer silicon-nitride-on-silicon photonic platform. © 2022 The Authors

articleTitle: Real-Time Feedforward Clock Recovery for Optical Burst-Mode Transmission
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We compare three feedforward non-data-aided clock recovery algorithms suitable for burst-mode reception in PONs and datacenters. Our experimental setup allows real-time OOK transmission at 3 Gbit/s. The tolerable clock frequency mismatch is 475 ppm. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Propagation Symmetry Enhanced Distortion Compensation by Optical Phase Conjugation via Step-Profiling Fiber Links
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Fiber spans tailored with stepwise approximate decreasing dispersion and increasing nonlinearity parameters demonstrate enhanced compensation of nonlinear signal distortion by optical phase conjugation. WDM-QAM signal simulations and experiment show gaining >1.2 dB Q<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>-factor and 5~6 dB power tolerance over non-profiled links.

articleTitle: Single-span IM/DD Transmission over 120-km SMF with a Silicon Photonic Mach-Zehnder Modulator and THP
publicationTitle: 2022 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate up to 120-km dispersion-uncompensated transmission in a SiP MZM-based IM/DD system. 28/42-Gbaud DSB PAM4 signal is transmitted over 80/120-km SMF enabled by Tomlinson-Harashima precoding and receiver-side linear equalization. © 2022 The Author(s)
